Her mother, Circe Took, is said to have gone completely apeshit and to be on her way to the Earth system to do something about it, though it is too late for her to join the hunters. Carl tells every questioner that Vrah will be dealt with soon enough.

beats.headline: An antichrist, apparently
beats.text: Nihit's brother is married into the Blood Sultanate and will be on the ninth floor, Zev says, and Nihit wants Donut and me out before we get there. He thinks we're some antichrist sent to bring about the apocalypse. A small but growing conspiracy. Most everyone else loves us. It puts the crown back in my head, and the job it left Donut, and I ask whether Nihit thinks there's a way to hurt those guys down there. Zev sighs. Worry about surviving the sixth floor first, Carl.

beats.headline: Binding after it is gone
beats.text: Donut lost the crown at the end of the third floor, and it was regenerated and possibly awarded to someone else. The status stayed with her. Carl knows the description by heart: wearing it places you permanently in the royal line of the Blood Sultanate, and royals must slay the Sultan and every other member of the family before descending to the tenth floor. The royals, he now knows, always make it to the end. Anyone else who put the crown on would have to die too.

beats.headline: Warrants, and who buys them
beats.text: Carl, we can't bring you anywhere. Nihit has been healed and wants to press charges for assault. It was off system, so the regular rules apply, and you are not a full citizen. If they prosecute, the charges are shelved until you're out, and then you get a warrant with a sentence, usually two or three cycles. Licensed corporations can buy out warrants when they need workers. It is not true slavery. They get paid when they get out. They're criminals.

beats.headline: The same gift, the same day
beats.text: She and the Plenty each send protection against vampirism, and the two parcels arrive together. Sponsors are not supposed to coordinate. Carl now has two who do.

beats.headline: Fifty cycles of chasing
beats.text: Carl's silver box from the Apothecary holds two pieces of paper: a potion recipe and a drawing of Mongo. Mordecai squeaks. He has been chasing this one for fifty cycles. You don't chill it, you put it in the centrifuge and then flash-freeze it. So simple. He has the ingredients, too: the thorn sap tips Carl has collected by the dozen, and the hard one. They both turn to look at Mongo. The recipe is for Charm Animal, which has to be brewed for a specific animal. Absolutely not, says Donut. It's just blood, Carl says: a liter of it, collected outside a saferoom. Per potion, Mordecai adds.

beats.headline: A red gem, and 403 gold
beats.text: A red gem has been added to Donut's leadership charm, for a small-sized settlement. It gives plus two to intelligence, plus one to dexterity and a few points in some spear-throwing skill she will never be able to use, which annoys her, especially since its tax stipend is only 403 gold every ten days.

beats.headline: All four legs
beats.text: Donut's gold box pops out a sparkling silver bracelet with little purple gems, and she equips it at once. The obsidian bracelet that lets her cast Fireball moves to her right foreleg and the new one goes on the left. The fallen oak anklet stays tucked on one back leg and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the other. With bracelets on all four legs, she can't add any more. Doesn't it look divine?

beats.headline: A goat on a sponsor's patch
beats.text: A gold box from the Plenty holds a jacket patch: black denim, a gray goat head. Crawler Carl has seen the symbol tattooed on the back of Prepotente's hand and had assumed it belonged to a deity. My description: the Midnight Epicure, the Caprid Who Devours the Sky. Eat your dinner, or he comes to eat it for you, and then every child in the home. The symbol, really a racist caricature of an adult caprid, became a ward against all night evils. Protection against Vampirism and Lycanthropy. Mordecai says sew it on at once.

beats.headline: The Plenty's goat
beats.text: Carl's gold box from the Plenty hisses, spins and opens like a flower on a patch for his jacket, the same size as his white bomb patch: black, denim-like material with a gray goat head screen-printed on it. Donut mutters about screen printing. Read the description, says Mordecai, and sew it on right away. Carl has seen the satanic goat before, on the back of Prepotente's hand, and sketched it into the cookbook, assuming it was a deity's mark. The description calls it a fable. Its benefits are exactly those of the silver bracelet Donut has just pulled from her own box.

beats.headline: He testified against Odette
beats.text: I'd like to see that one go to trial. Odette's was a farce, a whole production, and she pleaded down to a lesser charge just before they reached a verdict. Yes, kid, I saw it. I testified in it. Against her. She wasn't charged when she was a crawler, which was long before me. It was when she was my manager. Now open your boxes and get back out there.

beats.headline: Fifty cycles chasing a recipe
beats.text: The Apothecary's silver box is a potion recipe and a drawing of Mongo. Holy cow. I've been chasing this one for fifty cycles. You don't chill it: you put it in the centrifuge and flash-freeze it. Of course. So simple. Charm Animal, brewed for one animal, and the special ingredient is a liter of that animal's blood, per potion. We've got the thorn sap tips. We've got the last ingredient too, and he's hiding behind Donut. I'll make him a sleeping potion, Donut. He won't even know.

beats.headline: A sliver of amethyst
beats.text: Killing a mayor has earned Carl a gold Tyrant's box. It holds a sliver of an amethyst, smaller than the poor sapphire already on his necklace, and it gives him three points of dexterity and nothing else. Donut's red gem on her own leadership charm gave two intelligence, one dexterity and a few points in a spear-throwing skill she will never use, and its small settlement pays her only 403 gold every ten days, which annoys her.

beats.headline: Not a drop of Mongo
beats.text: The Apothecary sent me a gold box, and in it a silver bracelet with little purple garlic gems that protects against vampirism. It is divine, even if the description reads like the AI is having a stroke. Then Carl and Mordecai read a recipe and look at Mongo. A liter of his blood. Per potion. Absolutely not. I am Mongo's mommy, and he trusts me implicitly. Mongo, come here this instant where Mommy can protect you. Mordecai says he'll make him sleep. I'll know, Mordecai.

beats.headline: A bracelet on every leg
beats.text: Donut's own gold box holds a sparkling silver bracelet with little purple gems, and she equips it at once. She moves the obsidian bracelet that lets her cast Fireball to her right forward leg and puts the new one on the left. With the fallen oak anklet on one back leg and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the other, she has a bracelet on all four legs and cannot add any more.

beats.headline: Purple, like garlic
beats.text: Carl's gold box from the Plenty gives a patch; Donut's gold box from the Apothecary gives a sparkling bracelet, and she equips it at once. The obsidian Fireball bracelet moves to her right foreleg, this one goes on the left, and with the fallen oak anklet and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the back legs, all four legs are full. She loves it, though the description sounds like the AI is having a stroke. Its purple gems are shaped like bulbs of garlic. It protects against vampirism and lycanthropy, with plus 25 percent magical damage against sapient undead. Carl's patch gives the exact same benefits. Mordecai grunts: the two sponsors really are working together.

beats.headline: Two sponsors, one gift
beats.text: The Plenty and the Apothecary each send Carl and Donut something that protects them against vampirism, and they arrive together. Sponsors are not supposed to compare notes. These two plainly do.

beats.headline: What she actually wants
beats.text: The party goes back into the town for Miriam and finds Big Tina standing in it again, and this time the shape of the thing comes clear. The dinosaurs of the Hunting Grounds were ursine before Scolopendra's nine-tier attack turned them into what they are. Tina was a child when it happened. What she wants, under all of it, is to dance at a recital, because hers was stopped before her turn came. She is also a vampire now, and she is building undead out of what she brings down.

beats.headline: That's not what we do here
beats.text: She saved my life. If it's a trap to turn us, we're protected, and I'm not abandoning her. I sew the Plenty's goat patch on myself, wide stitches over Katia's careful ones, while Donut complains it isn't straight. In the hockey pub a barmaid named Prudence is hiding two cubs behind the counter, and after she has told us about Tina, the bloody bear claw by the door drops off the wall and inches out into the rain. A glamoured fragment, a minion of Big Tina. So that's why they gave us the vampire stuff.

beats.headline: Napalm for vampires
beats.text: Mordecai has an idea before they leave: two potion balls, dipped in the red water of the Emberus shrine at the back of the room. The system labels them Holy Goopers. Blessed water, a fine healing potion and an air-activated coagulant: Emberus is a light-based god, and against vampires the mixture acts like napalm. Hit them with it, he says, then have Donut max out her Torch spell.

beats.headline: Napalm to vampires
beats.text: As Carl heads out to Miriam Dom, Mordecai calls wait, hops sideways into the crafting room and comes back with two potion balls in his small arms. He dips them in the red water of the Emberus shrine at the back of the room and hands them over. The system labels them Holy Goopers. Blessed water mixed with a fine healing potion and an air-activated coagulant, Mordecai explains: Emberus is a light-based god, and the shrine's blood water with a healing potion and the coagulant acts like napalm to vampires. Hit them with this, then have Donut max out her Torch spell. So they're holy water grenades, Carl says. Cool. Exactly.

beats.headline: Tina's mother, by name
beats.text: A barmaid hiding from Big Tina gives the record its missing line. Tina's mother survived the nine-tier attack in the form of a dinosaur, along with several of the other mothers from the night of the recital; they kill too, but they are not as deranged. She still tries to keep Tina from doing too much damage. In the past few nights she has stopped being able to. Her name is Kiwi. Carl informs Mongo of the implications. Princess Donut gasps.

beats.headline: Sewn on, not straight
beats.text: Mordecai suggests letting Miriam Dom die and collecting her gear in the morning: two sponsors who know more than Carl have just spent a fortune protecting him from vampirism, and a vampire is asking for help the moment the sun sets. She saved my life, says Carl, grabbing the sewing kit; if it is a trap, they will be protected. He sews the patch on beside the bomb patch, his wide stitches covering Katia's careful threading, and Donut gasps that it is not straight. It is good enough. An achievement, a few levels in sewing, and the patch glows as it is officially affixed.

beats.headline: Trapped under his arm
beats.text: The elite is dead and the quest is done. My boy killed him and was paralysed doing it, and the elite only died a few minutes ago, when the sun set. The paralysis was thirty-five hours; fifteen remain. His arm is around my waist, and if any part of him breaks, even his thumb, he will shatter. Bianca is in a carrier in his inventory. Through the daylight I alternated Revive and blood potions, and I have a handful left. I have asked for help for hours. The system would not let my messages reach Carl.

beats.headline: Small bears, hiding
beats.text: Big one outside. Roar. Mongo SCREECH. MOTHER say shush. Small bears behind counter. Scared. Mongo peep. Small bear say Mongo not bad one. MOTHER say Mongo nice.

beats.headline: Let her die, he says
beats.text: Or you let her die and collect her gear in the morning. Two sponsors who know more than you do just spent a fortune protecting you from vampirism, and a vampire asks for help the moment the sun sets. I know I'm not as valuable as I once was, kid, but I can see a connection. He's going anyway. So take these. Holy Goopers: shrine water, a fine healing potion and an air-activated coagulant in a potion ball. Emberus is a light god. To a vampire it's napalm.

beats.headline: Behind the counter
beats.text: For the record: the pub is dark and stinks of death when a voice behind the counter hisses at Crawler Donut to turn off her light. She is out there. She came in once already and ate the subject's husband right out of the doorway. The subject is a large bear in an apron with two small cubs clutched in her arms, and a Terrified debuff blinking over her head. Prudence. Level twenty-eight Ursine Barmaid. Yes, she says, that is Big Tina outside. She came back for her revenge, for what the clerics did.

beats.headline: The secret recital
beats.text: Her account. Dancing is forbidden, but a community of mothers taught the children ballet in secret and planned a small recital. The best dancer was eight years old, the daughter of the town's head cleric, and was to dance last. Her name was Tina. Her father found out and stormed the school with his clerics. Tina's mother slapped him in front of the congregation. He whipped her to the edge of death on the stage, pushed Tina aside, and she fell. The wand that was meant to shoot sparkles broke. Sinners get what they deserve, says her cub Randy. That's right, honey.

beats.headline: Her grandmother's faith
beats.text: Before the cleric could punish the others, the nine-tier attack came. Most died. Only females were transformed; a small handful survived unchanged, including the subject's grandmother, the most pious, whose faith saved her. Tina was the only child who turned, and her mind is gone. Her mother and several other mothers survive as dinosaurs, and her mother still tries to hold her back. Her name, the subject tells Crawler Carl, is Kiwi. Quest Update: The Recital.

beats.headline: Kill her or give her what she wants
beats.text: Quest Update. Big Tina is out of control, killing every ursine she can find, and if she is not dealt with soon the High Elves may field their army, which nobody wants. Kill her or give her what she wants. Carl assumes that means killing all the ursine. Princess Donut, who has seen Footloose, says it is obvious: she wants to dance, so they have to finish the recital. A second update arrives once the minions show themselves. Surprise, it says. You don't know the half of it.

beats.headline: A vampire, by coincidence
beats.text: Miriam Dom is trapped and asking for help as the sun sets. Mordecai suggests letting her die and collecting her gear in the morning. Two different sponsors who know more than they do just spent a huge amount of money to protect them from vampirism, he says, and by coincidence a vampire shows up asking for help. She saved my life, Carl says, grabbing the sewing kit. If it's a trap to turn them into vampires, they will be protected.

beats.headline: The pile down the street
beats.text: Big Tina has not been idle in the street. She has been calling the two-day-dead to her, and other dinosaurs have been hauling body parts in from the whole forest into a heap like a sorting facility, where the fragments crawl about finding their matches. Levels add as the pieces rejoin, and at seventy percent of the whole a body becomes something quite deadly. One fragment has reached level 42 at 21.8%. Carl sets missiles on the pile and leaves. She roars. She does not follow.

beats.headline: The top fifty might be a trap
beats.text: The chat fills with vampire animals: the half-genie owl Gideon just fought, Tserendolgor's drillbeaks. I ask who's in the top 50, because I'm listing everyone who might be at that party. Gideon isn't in the top thousand and likes it that way. Tserendolgor is 54 and trying to climb. I tell her not to try too hard. I think the party might be a trap, and we might need some people not at the top to rescue us. That flamethrower of hers might come in handy.

beats.headline: A storyline off the leash
beats.text: Miriam Dom's calls for help reach Carl late, carried by other crawlers, and the keyword in the previews explains the delay: Elite. Carl cannot help where an elite is involved. Miriam answers that the elite is dead and the quest is done; Pony killed him and was paralysed doing it. The rest follows. A vampire sickness is spreading through the dinosaurs of the forest, part of the elite's story, and he died before it could be stopped. For once, not something Carl or Donut started.

beats.headline: Not in the top thousand
beats.text: With vampirism spreading through the forest, the subject reports in: he just fought a half-genie, half-owl vampire that tried to rip his neck out, and his team's cleric killed it before it could get him. It was damn close. Crawler Carl asks who is in the top fifty, since that is who gets invited to the party. The subject is not even in the top thousand, and likes it that way.

beats.headline: It is spreading through the forest
beats.text: Carl asks whether we fought a giant dinosaur in a pink feathered necklace. We did. She carried a wand. I almost killed her, and then something happened and she escaped. He thinks I infected her. Yes. I know. Many of the dinosaurs in this area are vampires now, and it is spreading quickly. They are weak for the first few days, if they survive, and then they grow strong. It was part of the elite's story. He died before it could be stopped. You must help me.

beats.headline: Now you can
beats.text: Crawler Carl tells the subject to take her children through the door they came out of. She tried it before, she says, and it would not let her. You can now, he says, and gives her and her cubs access. Once Big Tina has moved down the street, Prudence and her two cubs are inside the guildhall, and Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut go out into the rain.

beats.headline: Two vampires in the deck
beats.text: Allister, on vampires: his culture has them too, and his T'Ghee deck contains two vampiric forms. Both represent death and the end of days. One is deliberate, thirst-based evil. The other, the Plague Bearer, is a study in how poor actions ripple through time, amplify, and doom everyone. The vampires on the floor he is writing from, he thinks, are a combination of the two. It is strange, he writes, that the traditions are so different yet the same.

beats.headline: Ranked fifty-four, with ultraviolet
beats.text: Crawler Tserendolgor, some two hundred kilometres away, reports that the drillbeaks in her area disappeared almost overnight and came back as vampires, twice as strong and very fast. She believes a touch does not infect, only a severe injury. Ultraviolet cast on her flamethrower kills them quickly, and she is staying indoors in this rain. She is ranked 54, trying to reach the top 50 for the invitation. Princess Donut reopens the matter of stolen experience from three floors ago.

beats.headline: Through a vampire boss
beats.text: I levitate above the trees for Miriam's sparks, see them two kilometres south, and something hits me. Sierra, level 65 neighborhood boss, mount of a dead vampire hunter, turned in under a day after Miriam wounded her. Her talons try to pull me apart. One Holy Gooper sizzles on a foot; the second misses, but Donut's light sets her head on fire and she throws me up. I drink my half-splat potion and fall straight through her chest. She still won't die until I stake her loose heart with a branch.

beats.headline: A liter in the rain
beats.text: With the knockout potion in him, Mongo is asleep in a dryad town, and Donut has to collect the blood herself. Most of it goes all over the place, but a few wet monkeys help her hold the flask, which is really hard without thumbs, and there is no time for another liter. Mordecai only has time to make one charm potion. In the next town, Prepotente Number Seven, Carl rushes into the saferoom, grabs the finished green potion, and they bounce.

beats.headline: The last one, in midair
beats.text: Sierra tosses Carl straight up into the sky like a rag doll, and he drops face-first toward her as she writhes on the treetops with her head on fire. He slams down his last half-splat potion. It will keep him from dying, though it will drop his health to five percent, but the boss is not on the ground, and he has no idea whether the potion even works like this. His gauntlet forms, he tears straight through her like paper, and he keeps falling through the branches. His ribs crunch and his legs break in the mud. He hits Heal.

beats.headline: Against Sierra's talons
beats.text: Sierra has Carl in her twin talons, one round his legs and one round his chest, trying to pull him apart like a hot mozzarella stick. A magic missile hits her wing. Carl casts Heal and pulls the Holy Gooper into his free hand, smashing the sticky holy water against the talon on his chest. The foot sizzles, and she only crushes harder. He pulls his second and last as the new sun comes up and Donut emerges from the canopy. The throw misses when the boss rears back from the light, but her head bursts into flames anyway, and she tosses him straight up into the sky.

beats.headline: Knocked out of the sky
beats.text: In a freezing downpour, Carl needs to see the sparks Miriam Dom is shooting into the air. He downs one of the potions of Levitation and pushes the slider up through the trees, his cloak billowing. Far behind him the night glows with a big fire, and he reckons Donut has set the whole forest aflame. The sparks show two kilometres south. Then a screeching, frothing form slams into him from the side, the levitation snaps off at once, and he pinwheels down out of the sky until he freezes in midair to pounding EDM music.

beats.headline: Protected by the jacket
beats.text: Carl stabs the loose heart of the boss in the rain, and the monster explodes, showering gore over all of them and spilling the rest of itself from the ruined trees. When Mongo leans down to bite at the remains, Carl tells him not to dare. Vampirism is contagious, and Carl knows that if his jacket did not protect him he would likely be infected: he would die, then wake up overcome with hunger. Half the dinosaurs in the forest are infected already.

beats.headline: Glass of Mongo
beats.text: Sleep. Wake. Big glass of red. Smells like Mongo. NOT FOOD. BAD. Carl BAD. Next town, box on wall. Dinosaurs in box! Mongo jump. Mongo SCREECH.

beats.headline: It is my town now
beats.text: The dryad mayor offered me 5,000 gold to tie Carl up and bring him out. I'd have fireballed him on the spot, but the guards were all outside. So I filled a liter of Mongo in the rain, cutting and healing him three times, with wet monkeys holding the flask, because I don't have thumbs. Then at the western gate Carl said be careful, just the mayor, magic missile, not a... and I cast Fireball. It squeezed between two guards and hit him. Half the town burned. In the rain! It's my town now.

beats.headline: Dinosaur movies on the couch
beats.text: The subject sits on the couch with her cubs crawling all over her, acting like nothing happened. A Land Before Time sequel is on, which Crawler Carl finds a little fucked-up, since the cubs have just watched their dad get eaten by a dinosaur. They seem to like it. Little Todd complains to Mordecai about the accuracy of the dinosaurs.

beats.headline: Same kind of mob, in the flesh
beats.text: The boss that knocks Carl out of the sky over the forest is the same type of mob as Quetzalcoatlus, the pterodactyl-like ghost of the previous floor. Carl recognises the shape before he reads the name. This one is not a ghost, but it is still undead: a vampire in the flesh, like a pelican crossed with a vulture and the size of a flying giraffe, with a beak as long as Carl is tall.

beats.headline: Out of the storm
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Carl is levitating above the forest in a freezing downpour, and has just spotted Miriam Dom's sparks when something slams into him from the side. The spell snaps off and he falls, then freezes in midair as the boss music starts. Special Forest Encounter. Two talons hang fifteen feet away. The shape is the same kind of mob as Quetzalcoatlus from the last floor, but flesh and undead: a pelican crossed with a vulture, the size of a flying giraffe, a beak as long as Crawler Carl. Sierra. Northropi Vampire. Level sixty-five Neighborhood Boss.

beats.headline: A bereft minion
beats.text: Her description files her as a Bereft Minion of Viscount Fog, the now-deceased hunter of vampires, who trained his trusty mount never to leave his side. Together they hunted evil. When Fog set out to exterminate a newcomer, a vampire by the name of Miriam Dom, it went bad. Sierra swept down to save her master, was injured by Miriam, and stumbled away. In less than a day the bloodlust ravaged her. Now on the hunt for her first kill, she has become what she and her master hated most. Free her from her misery.

beats.headline: Holy water and a new sun
beats.text: Her talons close on Crawler Carl's legs and chest and pull, and his health flashes red. Crawler Donut's Magic Missile hits her wing. Crawler Carl heals and smashes a Holy Gooper against the talon on his chest; the foot sizzles, and she only crushes harder. Then Crawler Donut rises out of the canopy with her light turned up like a new sun. The boss rears back, her head bursts into flames, and she flings Crawler Carl straight up into the sky before landing on her back atop the trees.

beats.headline: A branch through the heart
beats.text: Sierra, northropi vampire, is dead. Crawler Carl falls out of the sky onto her, fist first, and tears through her chest. She hangs impaled between two trees with her head burning and her guts falling on him, her health in the red and refusing to drop further. Her heart lies on the ground, still beating in time to the music. Crawler Carl picks up a jagged broken branch and stabs it into the organ, and she explodes. Winner! Crawler Donut announces that he punched her in the lady garden.

beats.headline: The mount he left behind
beats.text: Sierra, Northropi Vampire, level sixty-five neighbourhood boss, is a Bereft Minion of Viscount Fog. The description is the file on both of them. The great, now-deceased hunter of vampires trained Sierra never to leave his side, and together they hunted the scourge that took his village and family. When he learned of a new bloodsucker named Miriam Dom, he set out to exterminate her. It went bad. Sierra was injured by the bloodsucker trying to save him, fled, and is now what they both hated.

beats.headline: His own ring, at dawn
beats.text: Miriam asked me here to kill her, and I say no. I tell her I will stand watch until the sun comes up instead. Then, with my hands behind my back where none of them can see, I slip my own Ring of Divine Suffering on just as dawn breaks. I have marked Miriam Dom. Her highest stat is Intelligence. Her bounty is 300,000, Prepotente's is 1.2 million, and it would be so easy. Donut asks if I would do the same thing to save her. Without hesitation.

beats.headline: She can see the glow
beats.text: Carl is still cautious with Miriam Dom, and she understands why. The two of them are in no danger from her, she tells him. She can see the glow on them: Carl and Donut are both protected from vampirism, and she could not feed on them even if she wanted to.

beats.headline: Marked by his ring, waiting for the sun
beats.text: Carl and Donut have found us. Prepotente is paralysed, with his arm still around my waist. In the last fight his Ring of Divine Suffering marked me. That is how it works: while I live, he cannot heal. And I am the head of this, so when I go, everyone it has touched is cured. I have asked Carl to do it before the paralysis wears off. He has said no. So we sit, and we wait for the sun.

beats.headline: Dust at sunrise
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom has been eliminated in a forest clearing on the sixth floor. Cause of death: sunlight, which she waited for. She had summoned the man to kill her. He declined, and stood watch with her instead. She died with her head on Prepotente's frozen shoulder, saying "my beautiful boy" twice. Bounty unclaimed: 300,000 gold.

beats.headline: She reads the spellbook anyway
beats.text: Miriam drops a spellbook at her feet and says I must read it to wake Prepotente up. Carl says wait. I do not wait: I cast Second Chance on a raccoon and have it fetch the spellbook, and I read it. Get Out of Jail, forty points, which is a lot. Then Carl tells me she wants us to kill her, and that if she dies everyone infected is cured and Prepotente can heal. I do not want to kill either of them. This is just like with Chris.

beats.headline: Two rings, one mark
beats.text: Prepotente had a ring of his own, freshly acquired against Miriam's advice. When his Community Pool spell bounced back and forth between him and Viscount Fog, the magical burst made his items misbehave, and his ring marked the only eligible target in reach, which was Miriam. Left to Fester: while she lives he cannot heal, and he has one point of life. Carl adds a second mark at dawn with his own ring, behind his back, where nobody present can see.

beats.headline: His flying mount
beats.text: In the clearing, Crawler Carl tells Miriam Dom that they have just killed Viscount Fog's flying mount, Sierra. Miriam's answer: good. She was dangerous. Fog, she explains, was the star of one of the programs this place runs, and started hunting her the moment she landed on this floor. The viewer counter has been jacked all the way to the right since the boss battle.

beats.headline: The star of Blood Hunter
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom, in a forest clearing, fills in the rest. Viscount Fog was an elite hunting her from the moment she landed, the star of one of the programmes run inside the dungeon, called Blood Hunter. His first attack came while she and Prepotente were fighting Big Tina. The climax was written in advance: the vampirism curse would spread through the forest, Fog would kill its progenitor, which is Miriam, and every infected dinosaur would be cured, stopping an apocalypse.

beats.headline: Community Pool, returned to sender
beats.text: The second attack. Prepotente reads Community Pool, which moves an infection from one party to another and would have made Fog the head vampire. Viscount Fog counters, throwing the spell back. Prepotente's Opposite Day ring throws it at Fog again, and Fog has a ring of his own. The spell ping-pongs between them several times in under a second. Both are stunned repeatedly, and the stuns compound. Past the third, the sufferer becomes Fragile, and the slightest damage kills.

beats.headline: Dust, at sunset
beats.text: The bounced spell came out inside out, as spells that bounce often enough do. Viscount Fog took a new debuff, Cursed Light Walker: where a vampire dies in light, his health seeped away out of it. Crawler Miriam Dom had him stunned and helpless and did not strike, in case he had one trick left that would take Prepotente with him. She did not need to. Frozen and unable to heal, he died when the sun set and crumpled to dust.

beats.headline: The seventh edition's only note
beats.text: For the record: the note added by Crawler Volteeg, Seventh Edition, runs to a few lines. He misses her. He misses her so goddamn much. Is it worth it, to survive this place with her gone? No, he does not think it is. Beneath it, Crawler Drakea of the 22nd Edition adds that this is Volteeg's first, last, and only entry in the cookbook, and: fuck everything about this place. At dawn, with Prepotente watching and unable to move, Crawler Carl is thinking of that line.

beats.headline: Three points, and a world quest
beats.text: A champion has fallen. I take the ring off and pocket it, and I help myself to two of Miriam's forty-odd Size Up scrolls where the goat can't see. A number fifty slams onto my interface. Then the AI announces a world quest: fifty Odious Creepers, built from the leftovers of Big Tina's army, all killed before sunset or something batshit happens. It helpfully tells everyone to ask why I have three new points of intelligence.

beats.headline: Doing the math on the creepers
beats.text: Carl gives me the rundown on Miriam. I have been doing the math from what he told me earlier, and some of these glamoured creepers were as high as level 150, maybe more, before they turned into plants. We will have to attack in groups, from afar. Eva's group has one right in the middle of them. If it does not take them out, we move in. Donut tells me to stay away from Tserendolgor. Her name is Mongolian.

beats.headline: Stay away from the creepers
beats.text: Listen to me. I think I've seen this on a smaller scale. Those glamoured fragments were going to become Glamoured Creepers, and with their boss cured something else has taken them over, probably an Odious Blossom. They rip parts off people and grow stronger. Poison darts. Up out of the ground. Something that big needs an aerosol, and delivery is the problem. The prize is too good, which means it's too dangerous. For the sake of the gods, stay away from them.

beats.headline: He swallows the ring
beats.text: The cat's spell works, and I can move. I take the Ring of Divine Suffering off and drop it in the dirt. Then I pick it up again and swallow it. I scream at what is left of her until the sound will not come. Oh, mother, what did you do. She was going to play piano for me like she used to. She was going to sing me my special song. And now, it appears, my sponsor has sent me an emergency benefactor box.

beats.headline: Two of forty
beats.text: Miriam Dom is a pile of dust, and beside it stands a stack of everything she owned, dumped from her inventory because she feared turning to dust would make her body unlootable. She was right. She told Carl he could take a few items for helping her, and he promised it would all go to Prepotente. He intends to keep that promise. Mostly. Among the potions and plants are over forty scrolls of something called Size Up. He walks out of Prepotente's sight and takes two. As the second goes into his inventory, his interface flickers, and the number 50 slams into place.

beats.headline: The Creeping Apocalypse
beats.text: World quest, no opting out. Miriam Dom burned away at sunrise while the callous Carl and Princess Donut watched and did nothing. Nothing! Ask Carl about his three new intelligence points. Her death cured thousands. It did not cure Big Tina's handiwork: fifty Odious Creepers, randomly placed and marked on everyone's map, plus a few thousand Shambling Berserkers. Kill all fifty before sunset. Plus five to a random stat per kill. Cowards sitting in Zockau, get to work.

beats.headline: Wings and a saddle
beats.text: Subject reappears in the clearing at level 40, up from 33 a few days earlier, the size of a large rhinoceros, with a full set of black smoking wings and a saddle. The dinosaurs screech; the clearing heats up. Ten levels short of full size. Prepotente mounts, informs her she may not eat any of them, and informs her further that they are no longer tethered to the ground or to moonlight. She lifts off with him, both burning in black flame.

beats.headline: Donut glows, then Kiwi
beats.text: The raptors have the party surrounded in a clearing, and Mongo stays in his carrier in case his presence negates the spell. Donut needs to be close: the potion lasts a minute, and she must not charm the wrong one. It is named Charm Mongoliensis now, and it tames the closest eligible monster as Donut's minion for the duration of the floor. She walks to within ten feet of the pink dinosaur, telling Kiwi she is forgiven but not forgotten. Donut glows, and about three seconds after her, Kiwi glows. Her dot turns white with the green mark of a minion, and every raptor in the pack turns white with her.

beats.headline: Charmed, and an escort
beats.text: Kiwi brings the pack in and Princess Donut charms her with a potion, and the fastest thing on the floor becomes an escort service. Carl works out at the same time that The Plenty arranged this entire chain of events, and that what it wanted out of the arrangement was its precious Prepotente protected.

beats.headline: LADIES
beats.text: MOTHER lets me out. KIWI! BITE. So many LADIES.

beats.headline: Nobody responsible may exist
beats.text: A wand makes a safe space for three minutes, and I spend it opening my boxes. The legendary benefactor box holds a spray applicator and a recipe: fine healing, blessed water and a weedkiller, turned to mist. I take five potions from Carl as payment for the Size Up scrolls he stole from my mother. Then Bianca, with wings now, and a saddle. If I cannot exist in a world with my mother, nobody even remotely responsible for her death can exist in it either.

beats.headline: A pump and a tin can
beats.text: Prepotente spends his wand's tiny three-minute safe space opening his loot boxes, which Carl thinks is a waste. Ten seconds before it closes, his legendary benefactor box gives up two items. One looks like a handheld bicycle pump with a tin can welded under the nozzle; Donut says it is like one of Bea's perfume bottles, and Carl recognises a sprayer for putting herbicide on a garden. The other is a piece of paper. Prepotente wants five fine healing potions from Carl, payment for the Size Up scrolls Carl stole from his mother, and Carl makes him tell what is on the paper first: fine healing, blessed water and a weedkiller, applied as a very fine mist through the new canister.

beats.headline: Rules for Kiwi
beats.text: I told Carl I am quite practised at taming dinosaurs, and I am. I walk up to Kiwi alone, tail straight, and she glows, and she is my minion. Rule number one is not to molest Mongo again. Rule number two is not to eat Carl. Then I let Mongo out and it all goes wrong at once, and so much for rule number one. And a terrible thought: did the Plenty want Miriam to die? Carl says yes.

beats.headline: Payment for the scrolls
beats.text: Prepotente needs at least five more fine healing potions for the recipe his benefactor box just sent him. Carl has about fifty and says he has a few. Give them to me, says the goat: consider it payment for the Size Up scrolls you stole from my mother. Carl pauses, then asks to hear what is on the paper first, and once he has, hands over five potions without further complaint.

beats.headline: Carl works out who arranged it
beats.text: Kiwi and her dinosaurs arrive, Donut charms her with a potion, and somewhere in the middle of it Carl sees the shape of the thing: his own sponsor set the chain of events up, and wanted Miriam Dom to die at the end of it. A benefactor box is not a gift. It is a production note with a bow on it.

beats.headline: A recipe he cannot admit to
beats.text: Mordecai doubts even my arm can soak these things with his weedkiller. I tell him the hobgoblin smoke curtains are basically the same thing: swap the brown smoke liquid for weedkiller, swap the charge for the magical one from the store so it won't catch fire. Twelve curtains per attack, bundled three to a trash can. He asks if I figured that out on the first try in five minutes. It took three tries, I say. It came out of the cookbook, and I can't tell him that.

beats.headline: The aerosol, disguised as smoke
beats.text: Carl needs Mordecai's weedkiller turned into a mist over a monster's head, and the cookbook has a bomb built for exactly that. He does not build the cookbook's version, which is smaller and stronger and would be impossible to explain. He builds a clumsier one out of modified hobgoblin smoke curtains and tells Mordecai he worked it out himself in three tries. Stripped of its charge, the device no longer counts as an explosive, so his throwing arm gets no help with it.

beats.headline: All business, level 54
beats.text: I come through from the guildhall in my big form with blood down my chest. Gwen and the others have two creepers cornered in the bush elf village with Eva's crew, and it is probably too late for most of the people there. Li Jun had been turned into a vampire and told nobody but his sister and Zhang, and I am still angry with him for it. He was cured when Miriam died. Then Eva gets credit for a kill while we stand here, and I tell Louis to come on.

beats.headline: Tent the House
beats.text: Okay so, my Extermination Professional class has this thing called Tent the House. I take a potion and spread it over, like, a whole area, and from the deck of the Twister even wider. Once every six hours, so three goes before dark if we start now. Mordecai says maximum distance, man. Also Mongo has a girlfriend and she's pink, and she's a lot bigger than him. You go, buddy. I grab the last two jugs on my way out.

beats.headline: Uncle Morty's Insta Lawn-Kill
beats.text: He swallowed it whole? You're all crazy. It'll make its way out again. Four jugs on the counter: Uncle Morty's Insta Lawn-Kill and Undead Repellant, Extra-Strength Edition. I took a weedkiller built for an odious bloom and stacked anti-undead boosts on it, like the holy grenade I made the kid. Two or three creepers a jug. Do not get close. Apply it at maximum distance. It's flammable, and if it burns before it soaks in, it won't work. Nobody listens to Mordecai anymore, do they?

beats.headline: Mordecai builds on it
beats.text: A System message: another Odious Creeper has fallen, credit to Crawler Prepotente, forty remain. That is his third, says Carl. On the counter, Mordecai has four moonshine jugs of his own weedkiller, built on what Prepotente said and what he received: a weedkiller designed to take out an odious bloom, with several anti-undead boosts added, like the holy grenade he once made for Carl.

beats.headline: Samantha in her lap
beats.text: Back in the saferoom, the subject sits on the couch with a cub on either side while a nineties horror movie with an animatronic tyrannosaurus plays. Samantha is in her lap, having her hair stroked by the bear. Crawler Carl does not ask. Bomo and the Sledge watch the screen with the rest of them.

beats.headline: He is going to use me
beats.text: He is going to use me. I have been on the bear's lap having my hair stroked and nobody asked me, and now they are talking about throwing things at a monster. Carl pats my hair and says not this time, the bomb is too big to tape to my head. Maybe if they have to, he says. Then Louis leaves, and Juice Box is so lucky.

beats.headline: Four jugs on the counter
beats.text: Katia asks whether Mordecai made the stuff. Four moonshine jugs of bubbling yellow liquid sit on the counter, one almost as big as he is, labelled Uncle Morty's Insta Lawn-Kill and Undead Repellant, Extra-Strength Edition. He took a weedkiller designed to take out an odious bloom and added anti-undead boosts. Each jug has enough for two or three, maybe four. Louis's Tent the House ability spreads a potion over a wide area, but he must use it at maximum distance: the stuff is very flammable, and if it catches fire before it is absorbed, it will not work. Carl takes two jugs, Louis the other two.

beats.headline: The trebuchet was the answer
beats.text: The elven rock chucker we took off the Dream hunters has a little cup on the sling: pour a potion in and it changes the Poison Cloud. So we'd had a way to kill these things all along. Donut climbs a tree and spots. On the sixth rock we're on target and the AI calls it a bitch move, B'sieging, Silver Siege Master Box. Seventh rock carries the weedkiller, and the creeper dies. Crawler Princess Donut gets the credit. The spotter usually does, Mordecai says. Forgot my ass.

beats.headline: Level 173 and loving it
beats.text: That thing was huge. Level 173, and it poked holes all over the Twister's garden. Most fun I've had since we got to this ridiculous floor. The little dinosaur cat is sulking that hers was only 138. Carl's pointing us at the next one fifteen miles west, right up against the edge of the map, and Katia says we're already on it. Louis says he doesn't know if he can stomach it again.

beats.headline: Familiar to Queen Imogen
beats.text: Update to the file. The party runs into the High Elves. The High Elves have a queen, Queen Imogen, and the queen has a familiar, and the familiar is Ferdinand. Yes. That Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo. Crawler Princess Donut puts herself between the blast and her dinosaur and lives only because of a cockroach ability, which is not a sentence I expected to generate this season. Some families skip the reunion. This one held it anyway, and it went about how you'd think.

beats.headline: Her familiar is Ferdinand
beats.text: My familiar is Ferdinand. My elves are out among the creepers when they come upon the man's party, and Ferdinand takes exception to the dinosaur and strikes at it. The cat puts herself between them and takes the blast. She should not have got up from that. She does, on some cockroach's trick of hers, and she is quite well. I am told this with some amazement. I do not share it.

beats.headline: She keeps pulling east
beats.text: Minion Kiwi obeys Princess Donut, broadly. On the road southeast she veers the party east every half hour until corrected. Halfway there she lifts her head and howls, and the whole pack of thirty-odd raptors vanishes into the trees, sent to look after Big Tina. Left with three companions, she eats constrictors dropping out of the trees faster than anyone else can move. When the rhinoceros's rider fires at Mongo, she leaps at the litter, bounces off its shield and lands on fire.

beats.headline: Kill credit, Louis Santiago 2
beats.text: We tent the house from the Twister and the creeper goes down, and the system gives the kill to Louis Santiago 2, which is me. Firas says it poked a bunch of holes in the garden with thorns like ballista bolts. Elle says level 173 and most fun she's had all floor. Carl says go for the one fifteen miles west when my spell resets. I don't know if I can stomach that again, man.

beats.headline: She catches the lightning
beats.text: The queen's familiar talks to us from a curtained box on a rhinoceros, in a creepy voice, and says I am to dance with him at the Masquerade. Then the curtain moves and lightning comes straight at Mongo, and I jump in front of it. I am knocked out for a minute. Carl says I saved Mongo's life. I heal them both, and then I tell Carl what I saw through the curtain. It was Ferdinand.

beats.headline: Weedkiller from the deck
beats.text: Louis's Extermination Professional class has an ability called Tent the House, which delivers a potion over a wide area, wider still cast from the deck of the Twister, once every six hours. Loaded with Mordecai's weedkiller, Katia and the others move in on an Odious Creeper using the Twister, and the kill is credited to Crawler Louis Santiago 2, who is not sure he can stomach that again. By the time fifteen more creepers have fallen, Louis has killed three.

beats.headline: Into the sling cup
beats.text: Carl's delivery system was over-engineered. The venomous elven rock chucker taken from the Dream hunters has a Poison Cloud enhancement, and a potion poured into the little cup on the side of the sling changes the poison. A mile short of the creeper, in the mud and rain, Donut climbs a tree to watch. Carl adds the poison, hits the lever, and a rock flies. You hit it perfectly, says Donut; the green stuff is getting all messed up by the rain. Mordecai said that would help. A few seconds after that, the notice comes: a creeper has fallen, credit to Crawler Princess Donut. Thirty remain.

beats.headline: The cup on the sling
beats.text: Carl's poison delivery system was over-engineered. The rock chucker's Poison Cloud is not self-contained after all: pour a potion into the little cup on the side of the sling and it changes the delivery poison. There still has to be a projectile, and he has plenty of three-hundred-pound rocks. In the rain and mud, a mile short of the nearest Odious Creeper, he spikes the trebuchet into the grass while Donut climbs so high up a tree that he cannot see her. He has no idea how to aim it, so the first rock goes without the potion: she can tell him if it is close.

beats.headline: The spotter takes the credit
beats.text: Next attack will contain the poison, Carl writes, and if it works he can keep his garbage can poison bombs for something else. He adds Mordecai's weedkiller to the trebuchet and hits the lever. You hit it perfectly, Donut reports; the green stuff is getting messed up by the rain. A few seconds after the shot, the System announces that an Odious Creeper has fallen and Crawler Princess Donut has been given credit for the kill. Thirty remain, and she is up two levels to 47. Mordecai says he forgot to mention that the spotter usually gets the lion's share of credit with siege equipment. Forgot my ass, Carl thinks.

beats.headline: She is brought in, and does nothing
beats.text: The dinosaur squad comes back to Carl and Princess Donut with Big Tina walking in behind them, and everybody in the clearing braces for the obvious. The obvious does not happen. Kiwi puts herself between the boss and the crawlers, and Tina stops. Nobody present can yet say why that works.

beats.headline: He wants to take her down early
beats.text: I tell the chat we're taking the nearest stairs. Katia reminds me the Sledge goes down with Donut and never casts Zerzura. Imani says I'm abandoning them. Elle says they already have Florin for broody. It isn't about them: they brought her old cat in here, and I can't stop thinking of Ikicha's note, or who they parade out next. My dad, maybe. Then Donut tells me flatly we are not going down early. Imani and Louis ratted me out, separately. And a Gold Benefactor Box lands from the Pacifists.

beats.headline: Ikicha's last entry
beats.text: Ikicha wrote of seeing someone he loved, twisted and changed, speaking in the same voice, and told the next reader not to try: hope is crucial, but blind hope is poison. Drakea's note under it says it took a while to understand him. Gone is gone. Everything else is puppets built by the enemy. And yet she dreams of a fire across the sky. For you, Ikicha. Carl read it a while ago. With Ferdinand on a rhinoceros, he cannot stop thinking about it.

beats.headline: The Creeping Apocalypse, failed
beats.text: The world freezes. Quest Failed. Two Odious Creepers survive, where only the hunters holed up in Zockau could reach them, so that is where it starts. First, the blood bar: saferoom time is now earned by killing. Then the punishment. The spell Gehenna Bramble has been cast, spreading at an average four and a half kilometres an hour, faster at night, slower in sun. Every plant it touches becomes a ten-metre wall of thrusting thorn vines. Pricked, your blood boils away, and you explode. It cannot be countered, poisoned or killed.

beats.headline: Beaten back, never stopped
beats.text: The rest of the rules. The brambles can be beaten back, but they are relentless. They do not come within five square metres of a stairwell. Everything else is to be encompassed, towns and buildings included, anything that is not a saferoom. Mordecai's advice arrives in the chat: Gehenna vines are dangerous, stay away from them, but if you get close, chop a few brambles off and save them. The toxin is very valuable. Don't touch the thorns. Carl, facing an angry dinosaur, answers: Not now.

beats.headline: Not over chat
beats.text: Carl wants to jump down the stairs five days early, and I tell him it is a knee-jerk reaction he will regret. We brought the changelings and Bonnie here for this. Then, outside the group chat: please don't go down yet. I need to talk to him about something, and I have been putting it off. Not over chat. It is not about Eva. That slippery bitch got away again. It can wait until we are through whatever happens next.

beats.headline: She stands in front of a city boss
beats.text: The squad comes back to the crawlers with Big Tina walking in behind it. Big Tina is an immortalized city boss and everyone in the clearing understands exactly what that means for the next few seconds. Kiwi steps in front of her. Tina does not attack. Nobody yet has an explanation for it that they would put in writing.

beats.headline: A mother now, over it
beats.text: We are not going down the stairs early, Carl. It is not even a discussion. Ferdinand may have been my first love, but I am a mother now, and I have more important responsibilities. Mongo needs me, and if I am going to pursue a singing career I cannot be all emotional because my ex-boyfriend is suddenly trying to get back into the picture. It surprised me, I admit. If Taylor Swift or Adele can profit off heartache, so can I. It will make a good song.

beats.headline: One arm, one creeper
beats.text: Crawler Quan Ch, one-armed, unreported all floor and long since off the top ten, has been credited with one of the fifty Odious Creepers. With two creepers still standing, the tally carries his name alongside Prepotente's ten, Louis's three and one for Lucia Mar. Crawler Carl briefly wondered whether the arm grew back. Nobody has seen him to say.

beats.headline: The blood bar
beats.text: The failed creeper quest puts every saferoom and personal space on the floor under tenth-floor rules. A full blood bar buys ten hours inside. At zero the occupant is teleported to a random spot outside, and cannot enter a saferoom, guildhall or pub at all. The bar fills by killing, and it counts retroactively, so anyone who has killed nothing all floor starts empty. Moments after that, a hunter drops into the woods beside Carl and loses a leg to a raptor within seconds.

beats.headline: Everything they had worked for
beats.text: The System, introducing Big Tina, runs down who paid for the nine-tier attack. The Over City was devastated. The residents of the Hunting Grounds were transmuted, all but the high elves. And the Semeru dwarves of Larracos lost everything they had been working for. Even the celestials, and their downstairs neighbours in Sheol, found their destinies altered that day. It is a list. The Semeru get one line of it.

beats.headline: Holy shit. You idiots.
beats.text: Quest failed. I warned you. The last two creepers were right where only the hunters could reach them, so it starts with you in Zockau. New status bar: the blood bar. Saferooms and personal spaces run on tenth-floor rules now. Kill things to fill it; sit at zero and you get thrown out, or can't get in at all. Retroactive, by the way. And the punishment: Gehenna Bramble, spreading at four and a half kilometers an hour. Prick yourself, your blood boils away. You brought this on yourselves.

beats.headline: Tied to Donut's bodyguard
beats.text: Carl wants to take Donut down the stairs five days early, and Katia has an objection. The Sledge is assigned to Donut. If they go down now, he goes too, and the Zerzura spell never gets cast. Carl's answer: he promised Juice Box to do his best, not that it was a sure thing. Katia reminds him that the changelings have been risking everything to reach the Desperado Club every day in case he turns up with the plan.

beats.headline: Iota talks, then dies
beats.text: The hunter who fell into our laps is Iota, a Crafter, an accountant, drunk. Donut says kill him now. I put my foot on his chest instead and pull one of his nipple rings out with my toe until he explains: families sued to get the hunters out, the court agreed, and the AI nullified the ruling on its own authority. He says it's going primal, and they dropped him on me on purpose. He isn't afraid. I crush his chest mid-sentence. The ring levels up: four points a kill.

beats.headline: A hunter uses the word about the AI
beats.text: Iota tells Carl the AI is starting to go primal: ignoring court orders, doing as it pleases. He says the rumour on his side is that the Mantises sold Borant a used one under the table. Carl kills him. The word stays.

beats.headline: You're acting weird
beats.text: Carl has his foot on a hunter's chest and he is talking to him. He is doing it again. He is the one who says it is too dangerous to keep them alive, and I tell him so: kill him now. He does not. He pulls a nipple ring out with his toe and pours a potion on the man's face and listens to him for ages. Carl, are you okay? You are acting weird.

beats.headline: Congratulations, Murderer
beats.text: Carl kills Iota, the drunk hunter teleported into his lap by the new saferoom rules, by crushing his chest with one foot in mid-sentence, after pulling a nipple ring from him with a toe. Iota's highest stat was Intelligence, so the kill pays three points. Then the ring itself levels: Congratulations, Murderer. It now gives four stat points for every kill.

beats.headline: The dot turns white
beats.text: Tina gives up on eating the party and wanders off howling, half the pack behind her. She comes back into the light of Princess Donut's spell, head low, and tries to hide behind a tree like a shy child. Kiwi walks over, grunts at Mongo to come too, and he creeps up with Princess Donut on his back, head to the ground. Tina sniffs at him from a distance while her mother stands between them squawking. Her dot blinks from red to white.

beats.headline: Zapped out on an empty bar
beats.text: Zapped away by the new rules. Blood bar empty. I'm outside now, not too far off. I haven't killed a thing this whole floor, and Katia hadn't noticed. Her group is coming for me on the way to the southeast corner.

beats.headline: The foot bath
beats.text: Donut says the foot was gross and dangerous. Iota was level 50 and never leveled once. I loot him: the other three nipple rings, all magical, 498 healing potions, twenty blitz sticks, 400 gold and over forty kinds of alcohol. Donut says if something is going to go crazy, it's best it likes me, and brings up Miss Beatrice's friend Trixie. Trixie didn't break into that house because she disliked the guy. A raptor licks the gore off my foot, and I let it. We have a recital to prepare for.

beats.headline: Finished just as the timer runs out
beats.text: Carl asks Katia how far the changelings' hideout is from this Gehenna bush thing. Far, she says; they have a few days, but the Sledge's spell only works on the last day of the floor, and that is too late. She has done the math, and she is pretty sure it happened at just the right time to finish covering the map just as the timer runs out. Carl guesses where it ends. The southeast corner. Bingo: the high elf castle. The elves, he reckons, are going to try to beat the branches back.

beats.headline: The brambles point at it
beats.text: Katia works the growth rate out. By the last day the creepers will have taken the whole floor, and the one place they finish is here. Katia's party starts moving that way, and Carl means to meet them there.

beats.headline: The brambles end at the castle
beats.text: Carl asks how far the changelings are from the brambles. Far. They will have a few days, but that is it, and the Sledge's spell on the last day will be too late. Someone has to reach them through a Desperado Club, fast. I have done the math: the brambles finish covering the map just as the timer runs out, and the last corner is the high elf castle. We start that way, mapping stairwells, and first we go and get Britney. She has not killed a thing all floor. Her blood bar was empty.

beats.headline: Quarter Fall, through the left
beats.text: Four nipple rings off Iota. One gives plus five to Drink Mixing. One shows an item's average sale value. The third gives Quarter Fall, a fall at a quarter of normal speed, and I groan because I'll have to wear it. The fourth, plus ten constitution, is for Donut, who says absolutely not. She says I go first. I shove the needle through my left nipple. New Achievement: Sex Pervert. Reward: whores don't get rewards. I tell the ceiling it made that one up.

beats.headline: The note under the note
beats.text: A benefactor box note, with extra words that appear once Crawler Carl's Escape Plan skill activates: Circe sponsored Diwata. Vrah's mother is coming into the game. The box was sent before the party failed the odious creeper quest, so she had already bought the god before winning the court case to free her daughter, and meant to come for him whatever happened. His reading: she needs to save face. He humiliated her and injured her daughter, and somehow she is still talking to Vrah, which is against the rules.

beats.headline: One does not pierce cats
beats.text: It's not going to happen, Donut says: does she look like some sort of sex pervert? It gives plus ten and an additional five percent to her constitution, Carl says, and it is the smallest of the four; it will hide in her fur and probably shrink once attached. She will have to attach it manually the first time, and one does not pierce the nipples of cats; that is how one gets a visit from the ASPCA. Why doesn't he wear it himself? He is, Carl says, a bigger one. Of the four rings off Iota, two are for selling, the third gives Quarter Fall, and the fourth is this constitution ring, about the size of a nickel.

beats.headline: Bought with a sponsor prize
beats.text: A sponsor's note has just told Carl to give his new Pawna's Cries potion to Donut and keep it secret. If she puts the nipple ring on, he says, she gets his sponsor prize. She licks her lips. Mordecai looks about to speak, and Carl gives him a slight no. Donut agrees, if he goes first and they don't tell Katia. He shoves the needle through his left nipple. I don't think I can respect you anymore, Donut says, and an achievement arrives, Sex Pervert, whose reward is that whores don't get rewards. He searches her belly for a nipple. Not that one: up higher, on the other side. The top right. Okay, Carl says, he is going to count to three.

beats.headline: The forest cries
beats.text: Signet stops to warn Carl that a darkness spreads from the north. Yes, he says, he heard: the Gehenna brambles. It has only been a few hours, and it is moving slowly, likely just reaching the borders of Zockau, more than a day from the river. It is worse than he knows, Signet says. The trees are in pain, crying for help. The trees and dryads are casting a spell of their own. It cannot stop the plague, but if it works, help may soon arrive to protect them from the worst.

beats.headline: Smart Juice
beats.text: Carl asks whether I have an ability that raises the level of a spell. I do. An aura called Smart Juice. It adds a level to a spell, but it adds an extra cooldown as well, so I don't use it much in a fight. Elle gets mad when her icicles take too long. He says thanks, and nothing about what he needs it for.

beats.headline: Notes are paid by the character
beats.text: Notes are expensive. You pay by the character and the rules are complicated, so they force you into code; be too clear and the AI translates it for you, and you don't want that. Then I watch the kid hand the cat a plus-three potion from his own sponsor box, telling her it's so she can top off Magic Missile, and I don't buy it. I open my mouth. He gives me the smallest shake of his head. Fine. I move off.

beats.headline: A potion and a note in code
beats.text: Signet warns that the dryads may call Diwata against the spreading brambles. Then a potion turns up in the benefactor box with a note that says only 'Save the toraline', until Carl's Escape Plan shows him the rest: Circe has sponsored Diwata, the potion is for Donut, and it is signed P. Hu. Whoever writes these has a view of the board that nobody standing on it has.

beats.headline: Save the toraline
beats.text: Carl's benefactor box holds a familiar, valuable potion: Pawna's Cries, plus three to any spell or skill, limited shelf life, which means it must be taken before the end of the floor. His Pawna's Tears does the same at plus five, with no limit. This one comes with a note, which is unusual: Save the toraline. Notes are expensive, says Mordecai, and the rules force you to be cryptic. Then Carl's Escape Plan skill buzzes and more words appear. Circe sponsored Diwata. Give potion Donut. Need 15, but make it a secret. Prepotente, Imani and Samantha at the same time, or the other Pawna potion. Will replace.

beats.headline: The price of a nipple ring
beats.text: Donut will not wear the smallest of Iota's nipple rings, plus ten constitution and five percent more, so Carl takes out his new potion. Put it on, he says, and she gets his sponsor prize. You never give up your prizes, says Donut. She is almost at twelve in Magic Missile, Carl tells her, so in a few days she can use it to top that off. Mordecai looks as if he is about to say something, and Carl gives him a very slight no.

beats.headline: Or the other Pawna potion
beats.text: A benefactor box brings Pawna's Cries, plus three to a spell or skill, to be drunk before the floor ends. Carl still has Pawna's Tears, plus five with no time limit, and they are saving it. Then his Escape Plan reveals more words on the note: Circe sponsored Diwata, give the potion to Donut, fifteen is needed and should be kept secret, with a temporary boost from Prepotente, Imani and Samantha together. Or use the other Pawna potion if they have to. The sender will replace it.

beats.headline: Bribed with his sponsor prize
beats.text: It is a nipple ring and it dangles, and one does not pierce the nipples of cats. Then Carl offers me his sponsor prize, a potion of plus three to any spell, and Carl never gives up his prizes. I am almost at twelve in Magic Missile. Mordecai looks at him strangely. Fine, but he goes first. And do not tell Katia. I do not want her thinking I am a whore. He does his own, and I do not think I can respect him anymore. Top right, Carl.

beats.headline: Through the left nipple
beats.text: Of Iota's four nipple rings, two hold any real value. The biggest gives plus five to Drink Mixing, for bartenders; the next shows an item's average selling value; both are for selling. Carl groans at the third, because he will pretty much have to wear it: a glowing gold ring the size of a half dollar that imbues Quarter Fall, a fall at a quarter of the normal speed. Not a pleasant landing, but a survivable one, and better than the half-splat potions. Donut will wear the smallest ring only if he does his first, so he shoves the needle through his left nipple. New Achievement! Sex Pervert!

beats.headline: Kick me, little ones
beats.text: The little bears, Randy and Todd, are playing football, and I am the ball, and it is WONDERFUL. Kick me! Kick me, little ones! Oh, yes, just like that. Not the nose, sweetie, or I will kill Prudence. Carl looks at me rolling around the floor squealing and decides not to say anything.

beats.headline: Good, but not unique
beats.text: Carl's regular loot boxes are uninteresting, including the boss box from the one Odious Creeper they killed. It gives him a bunch of satchel bombs: basically little bags with leather handles that he can toss and detonate with the power of three sticks of hobgoblin dynamite, which is enough to level a small town. It is a good prize, but it is not anything unique.

beats.headline: The forest cries
beats.text: I wait for them at the edge of the town, with Holger and Areson, to warn them, and then we go, because the elves hunt us. Carl says the cat has tamed Tina's mother, not Tina. Be careful. The hierarchy is fragile; kill the alpha and the whole pack turns at once. Never rely on a single point of failure. And the trees cry out against the brambles. They and the dryads cast to summon Diwata, who does not forgive apostates. Stay away from the all-trees. They whisper.

beats.headline: Save the toraline
beats.text: A benefactor box brings a Pawna's Cries potion and, unusually, a note. It says simply: Save the toraline. More than half of it is already gone, into the potion that let Carl pull Maggie out of Chris's brain. Save it for what, Carl asks, and why won't they just spit it out? Notes are expensive, says Mordecai: they are paid by the character, and the rules force the sender to be cryptic. Then Carl's Escape Plan skill buzzes, and more words appear on the page.

beats.headline: Under 250 before we get there
beats.text: Edgar's castle map is on the table: a white cube, a ballroom for us on the fourth floor, one for the hunters on the second, staging areas for pets on the first. Louis does the math. Every hunter at the party means around 600 of them outside the doors when it lets out, against maybe a hundred of us. I agree. I want that number under 250 before we get there. Then Donut says Prepotente wants to know where we are, and she's already told him.

beats.headline: A surprise even to us
beats.text: Seventy hours until the masquerade, and the System has an announcement. The brambles are closing in! This event was a surprise even to us. Don't let those thorns prick you! The party is still on, but because of the bramble event, nobody is to be transported back when it ends. Crawlers are instead to be let out of the castle's southern entrance, not yet infested. The elves may or may not offer safe passage after, so prepare accordingly.

beats.headline: The map on the table
beats.text: The countdown to the Masquerade starts and the team goes over a map of the castle together, room by room. Donut's applications for the pet beauty contest and the talent show are both accepted.

beats.headline: 600 of them outside
beats.text: Level 42 now, almost double what I was when I met Carl. My blood bar's only half full from sitting in the guild, so I gotta get back out there with Firas and Britney. Then Samantha does this Hannibal thing with her tongue at me, man. So the map: if every hunter's at this party, that's like 600 of them outside the doors when it's over, and like a hundred of us. We'll get our asses kicked.

beats.headline: Tina as a backup dancer
beats.text: They accepted my applications! Both of them! The talent show rejected Carl's version because a crawler has to be the star, so I will be the star. I am going to sing, and Kiwi and Tina and the rest of the crew will be my backup dancers. Carl says he does not think that will work. Do not be such a Debbie Downer, Carl. Mongo, we're in! Mommy is going to sing, and you are going to win the beauty contest.

beats.headline: Zerzura, and the fine print
beats.text: Fifteen days back, I lay out the spell for my client. Zerzura moves a whole town, buildings and NPCs, one floor down. Terms: cast only at the end of a floor, one attempt, five minutes to cast, so we install it in a mercenary. The town lands at random, which means the worst place available, and everything it kills rises as a revenant that hunts the villagers and the caster until they are all dead. On these levels it skips floors. Remex learned that. Everybody will want you to do it. Everybody likes carnage when it's not them.

beats.headline: Goodwill ballrooms
beats.text: They are called goodwill ballrooms. Everybody knows that. You can entertain an ambassador without the risk of an assassination, and you may touch one another, lightly. It is in such a room that I met my king, and we had to wait until after the party to be together. When I have my body back and my sweet child, we will be a happy, normal family. My king likes swapping partners, I tell Louis. Carl throws me off the table.

beats.headline: The party rules
beats.text: Hunter casualties on this floor went from two percent to over twenty-five. Help is on the way, hunters. The next floor is a surprise we finished just in time, thanks to our new partners the Valtay. Top 50 crawlers get a plus-one token. At zero on your countdown you are teleported into the High Elf castle. No magic, no weapons, no inventory in the ballrooms. Pet beauty contest, talent show, prize booth for hunter hands and crawler scalps. Queen Imogen guarantees safe passage. You may kill each other afterward.

beats.headline: Borant's newest partners
beats.text: Seventy hours before the Masquerade, the daily announcement thanks Borant's newest partners, the Valtay Corporation, for the capital and help that let the next floor be finished just in time. That floor was not supposed to exist yet: what was going to be the seventh is now the eighth, with its difficulty raised to match. The Valtay have bought themselves a floor, and the crawlers are advised to stay as long as they can rather than go down early.

beats.headline: One floor down, and no steering
beats.text: Fifteen days earlier, Quasar explained the spell. It takes a full city or town, NPCs and buildings and all, and transfers it one floor down. No mobs, no red-tagged NPCs, no stairwells or prize rooms. It is hard on the caster, so it goes into a mercenary. It can only be cast at the end of a floor, it takes five minutes, and a miscast means no second try. The town cannot be steered. It lands at random, which in practice means the worst possible place.

beats.headline: The Children of Inpewt
beats.text: The catch, per Quasar. Everything the town lands on and kills rises as a powerful revenant, the Children of Inpewt, keeping its old spells. Everyone in the town, plus the caster, is marked, and the revenants hunt the marked until they are all dead; whoever they kill turns too. On the Scolopendra levels, it skips floors: Remex sent his army from the sixth straight to the ninth, and it was slaughtered. Carl thinks of Bonnie and Skarn and Ruby, and wonders whether this is really the only choice. Then he has a crazy idea.

beats.headline: Their boxes are for the cat
beats.text: Minutes after Prepotente delivers a potion his sponsor meant for Princess Donut, Elle announces a benefactor box from the Apothecary, and Imani messages that she has one as well. Imani has opened hers. It is also for Donut. Donut, meanwhile, decides out loud that Carl's nipple-ring bribe was a trick, and that he was directed to give her that earlier potion all along.

beats.headline: Carl says he approves
beats.text: Carl tells me he approves of Katia and me. I did not know how much I needed to hear it until it was said out loud, and I am ashamed of how relieved I am. I admit I had worried he had a thing for her himself. He says she is like his sister.

beats.headline: Do NOT give to Tina
beats.text: The potion the goat drops on the table is I Take It All Back: it removes any effect of Scolopendra's Transmutation spell. The tag on it reads like a Christmas present. Give this to Princess Donut. Use when the time is right. Do NOT give to Tina. That's the second benefactor item sent to someone else for Donut. I tell her not to use it until I say, and not to tell Signet, who would want it for Grimaldi. Then Elle and Imani both get Apothecary boxes, and Imani says hers is for Donut too.

beats.headline: Was the bribe a trick
beats.text: Don't let that nipple ring fool you, Donut tells Bautista: Carl doesn't get very many girls. Then Elle and Imani report benefactor boxes from the Apothecary, also for Donut, and Donut starts to think the nipple ring bribe was a trick, and that Carl was directed to give her that potion all along.

beats.headline: A package for Donut
beats.text: Prepotente screams in Elle's face, announces that he is here to deliver a package, and puts a black, bubbling potion on the table in front of Donut. He received it in a benefactor box and cannot fathom why his sponsor would give him something intended for her. Then he leaves, and Bianca screeches outside. It is the second benefactor item given to somebody else for Donut. A tag hangs off the top like a label on a Christmas present: Give this to Princess Donut. Use when the time is right. Do NOT give to Tina. Carl tells Donut not to use it until he says so, and not to tell Signet, who would want it for Grimaldi.

beats.headline: A package for the cat
beats.text: Level 70. Fifteen hunter-killer marks. Carl offers me a nap. I do not wish to rest or see his waste-of-money bathroom, and I do not wish to be involved in whatever he is planning. His idiot friends need not guard him; I wish him no harm. The floating one mentions goat recipes, so I scream in her face. Then I put the potion on the table. It came in my benefactor box. I cannot fathom why my sponsor would send me something meant for the cat. I leave.

beats.headline: My Katia?
beats.text: Carl says so, you and Katia, to Bautista, and Bautista says it just sort of happened. My Katia? Does she know this? Carl says it has been obvious for a while. Katia is outside. This is just as surprising as Louis and Juice Box. Carl, are you going to allow this to continue? Bautista thought Carl had a thing for her, which is silly. Carl is psychologically damaged thanks to Miss Beatrice, and I had no idea Katia was into furries.

beats.headline: A hundred harmless moths
beats.text: Bautista has a line of about a hundred gray and brown fuzzy moth or butterfly beanies. They came from his sponsor, but not in a benefactor box: he was pulled out of the dungeon to film a commercial and stole the sample box at the end of the session. Been there, says Carl. Bautista has tried them just once. They're harmless, he says. They don't attack. They just fly to the closest light source and suck the energy out of it. You can have one. You can have five.

beats.headline: Blood set to boil
beats.text: Assistant manager Astrid, level 125, Bloodlust Sprite, adept in cardiovascular magic, locates crawlers on the Hunting Grounds level where management has said they are not permitted. She does not open the door. She sets Crawler Carl's blood to boil through it and suggests he open it if he wishes to be allowed back into the club. The door is opened. His skin is bubbling and his health is falling. She was not trying to kill him. If she had been, he would already be dead.

beats.headline: Haxor, in the men's room
beats.text: Down the stairs behind the toilet, a seven-foot red hunter walks out of the men's room buttoning his pants and bumps into me. Haxor the Destroyer, Dreadnought, level 50, merchant. He opens his mouth to scream and I kick him in the nuts through the door, land on his chest, and break his neck by the horn stubs. Into my inventory he goes, credit chit and all. A towel over the cracked sink. It only counts if the guards see it.

beats.headline: Pearson and the map
beats.text: I hold a door shut against a crocodile guard while Pearson, a changeling wearing a cretin, tells me they don't trust me blindly. I give him the map and the plan: Zerzura works on a town, the elves have destroyed every town around them but the castle, so they have to be inside it. Juice Box told them to be careful of me. They don't even know if she's alive. She is, I say. Then my blood starts to boil, and Astrid is at the door.

beats.headline: Hunters stuck behind the door
beats.text: The crocodilian bouncer confirms the damage to management's arrangements. Since the hunters were stranded inside by the attack on Zockau, crawlers enter on the top floor and hunters may not come up. The entrance bar cannot be rebuilt without the approval of Zockau's mayor, the mantis whose crotch Carl set alight, and the mantises are keeping the hunters in. Seven have died. Then Princess Donut produces a ledger, and Clarabelle remembers a latch inside a toilet tank in the last stall of the women's bathroom.

beats.headline: Credit chit and all
