beats.headline: The shark loses his legs
beats.text: Jamal crosses the arena with his flamethrower roaring and Samantha on his head, landing on monsters and snapping them in half. His Tundra sits in a smoking wreck against the wall. When the god goes up, the blast throws him against the far wall and wrecks his legs until they fall off him. He is alive.

beats.headline: Smashed against the wall
beats.text: In the wreck of the arena, Imani calls for everyone to check in. The RV is broken in half, and the Tigran APV lies on its side. Mongo stands shaking his head, Rend is on his feet, and Gonk hides behind Simoom. Jamal is smashed against the far wall, his legs absolutely wrecked and fallen off him. But he is alive.

beats.headline: The warning holds
beats.text: Deep in the boss fight. Crawler Donut swaps herself with Penelope using one of Lucia's traps, the pig teleports in beside Khepri and picks up the temporary invulnerability, and when Emberus swings at Carl it is the pig who takes it, on account of a Four-Leaf Clover Patch. Then Emberus comes out through Scolopendra's side, and Taranis, who has been in love with this animal since a storyline we never ran, settles the matter personally. Whatever else has gone wrong in this arena, my warning held to the letter.

beats.headline: Two bolts, and Puddle Jumper
beats.text: Now. One of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps swaps me into the room and the pig out to Taranis's feet. Scorpion's Bite on my back, Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus loaded, and it goes straight into Emberus's eye. The second, one of my Danforth bolts, goes into the other, and he cannot move. Toodles. Puddle Jumper, level seventeen, and Carl and I are outside the arena door. When he tells me to get off his motorcycle, I tell him exactly where he can go.

beats.headline: Into the god's eye
beats.text: Emberus, sobbing, enraged and growing, rears back with a flaming ball in his hand. Donut zaps into the room through one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps with the Scorpion's Bite on her back and the crossbow cocked and ready. Loaded into it is Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus. Donut aims, and she fires true: the bolt buries itself in Emberus's smoldering eye socket. A second shot enters the other eye, one of her ten Danforth bolts, designed to hold the god in place.

beats.headline: He kills Emberus over the pig
beats.text: Emberus, pinned and made briefly vulnerable by two bolts from Princess Donut, swings at Crawler Carl. Penelope takes the hit instead, because of a Four-Leaf Clover Patch and the sort of luck this floor generates. Taranis kills him for it. A fire god, patron and quest-giver, removed from the arena inside a second by a thunder god defending a pig. I want everyone at home to appreciate the proportions here.

beats.headline: Through the arena
beats.text: In the arena the tenth-floor vehicles are in play, upgraded to the max, and it is a demolition derby. Jamal's Tundra lies in a smoking heap where it crashed into the wall. Jamal jumps through the arena with his flamethrower roaring, landing on monsters and snapping them in half, while Samantha sits right on his head, also screaming a war cry.

beats.headline: The ball in slot ten
beats.text: An effect from Eris has swapped every nearby crawler's inventory with the crawler closest to them, and Donut is holding Carl's. With ten seconds to Scolopendra's next attack he shouts for her to combine the ball in slot ten of his hotlist with the biscuit in slot twelve. There is no twelve, she shrieks; search and combine, he tells her, and she finds it and drops the ball into his xistera. He puts the motorcycle down, launching them into the air, and throws. The banger sphere with the Nothing Special enriched pet biscuit goes straight into the boss's mouth, and Scolopendra splatters into a quivering puddle the size of a small elephant.

beats.headline: What the actual fuck, Carl
beats.text: I put the bike down, launch us into the air, and throw the ball down Scolopendra's open mouth. The biggest thing in the dungeon splatters into a puddle the size of a small elephant. The achievement is the AI saying what the actual fuck, Carl, one word at a time, and admitting it's got nothing for a reward. Then Eris, huge, tells me I'm chaos incarnate and she doesn't need my worship. Every exit is an entrance. Don't forget the coin.

beats.headline: Search and combine
beats.text: Every inventory has swapped hands and Donut is holding Carl's. Racing at the centipede, he yells for her to combine the ball in his hotlist's slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve. Her hotlist only has ten slots. Search and combine, he shouts, fast. She finds it and drops the ball into his xistera, and he flings the banger sphere with the biscuit inside straight into Scolopendra's yawning mouth. The biggest, baddest entity in the dungeon splatters onto the arena floor, a gelatinous puddle the size of a small elephant.

beats.headline: Every inventory swaps at once
beats.text: Everyone holding something: hold out your hands. My Scavenger's Daughter effect goes off and every crawler here is carrying whatever the crawler nearest them was carrying. Donut gets Carl's. Carl does not blink. He asks her to put a bomb together with an enhanced pet biscuit, as though he had been waiting years for someone else to have his pockets. I adore him for it. I no longer need him to worship me, and I tell him so. Every exit is an entrance. I am leaving through one now.

beats.headline: Until the end of the twelfth
beats.text: With Scolopendra a puddle, Eris, huge, tells Carl she does not need his worship: he is chaos incarnate. Does he know how doors work? Every exit is an entrance. And don't forget about the coin, she says. They have until the end of the twelfth floor to figure out how the fifth side lands. Then she is gone in a puff of smoke, and the world unfreezes.

beats.headline: Laid down at Scolopendra
beats.text: With sixty seconds of invulnerability left, Carl rides his motorcycle across the arena at Scolopendra, Donut on his shoulder and refusing to get off. Eris swaps every inventory, so Donut has his, and he has her combine the ball in slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve. She drops the ball into his scoop. Carl yanks the bike down hard, launching them both into the air, and flings the ball into the boss's mouth. Scolopendra splatters into a puddle, and the motorcycle spins off the other way as they tumble to a stop.

beats.headline: His inventory is a disgrace
beats.text: Eris swaps everybody's pockets and I get Carl's, and it is not organised. Rocks, CARL. Why are there rocks. Why is a chicken and goblin recipe book in his hotlist. He shouts at me to combine the ball in slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve, and my hotlist only has ten slots, so I search and combine and drop it into his xistera, very fast, while the centipede glows.

beats.headline: She hitches a ride
beats.text: OKAY, CARL. I am going. Look me up when you get to the Ascendency. Don't mess up Sam Town, I used stuff from that snake guy's house you killed to decorate it. Now I am hovering by a very big god's ear, whispering, and he looks surprised, and he grabs me out of the air. Taranis and Krakaren and me. See you.

beats.headline: Inventories change hands
beats.text: Eris is near, and the Scavenger's Daughter opens her eyes and fills with power. The goddess of chaos brings a different effect every time; this one swaps the inventory of Carl and each nearby crawler with the crawler closest to them. Carl's own inventory is suddenly thousands of unsorted hats, Donut has his, and over chat Imani and Florin find they have switched too. Carl tells Donut to combine the ball in slot ten of his hotlist with the biscuit in slot twelve.

beats.headline: A biscuit down the throat
beats.text: A banger sphere carrying an enriched pet biscuit, thrown into her open mouth as the third attack spins up, and the level 500 Dungeon boss splatters onto the arena floor as a quivering puddle of goo. Uzi Jesus, firing his toy gun at the heap, reports a lot of people's auras inside it.

beats.headline: Two pieces of his mother
beats.text: Eris empties the arena's pockets and leaves. Khepri leaves. Taranis says he is taking two pieces of his mother with him, and goes, and what he takes with him is Samantha and Krakaren Prime. He does not explain the sentence. Nobody in the arena asks him to. I have the transcript and I have run it four times, and I am telling you exactly what he said and nothing more.

beats.headline: A toy gun at the heap
beats.text: Uzi Jesus appears on the arena dirt beside Crawler Carl, still tiny, mouth an O, apparently unaware that Eris could take this form. He fires his toy gun at the Scolopendra heap, pop-pop-pop, and reports that there are a lot of people's auras inside. He pokes the frozen Donut with the same gun. Then he climbs a snake tail onto Eris's shoulder, and leaves with her.

beats.headline: A ball, a biscuit and an open mouth
beats.text: Eris's effect swaps the inventory of Carl and each nearby crawler with the crawler closest to them, and Donut is holding Carl's. He has her combine the ball in slot ten of his hotlist with the biscuit in slot twelve. Hers has only ten slots, so she searches and combines, and drops the ball into the scoop as it forms on his arm. Carl puts the bike down to launch them into the air and flings it into Scolopendra's open mouth: a banger sphere carrying an enriched pet biscuit. The final dungeon boss splatters into a gelatinous puddle.

beats.headline: Carl's own roll call
beats.text: Scolopendra is 'defeated,' the stairwells have opened, and Carl sits in the dirt thinking of the impossible task ahead: the NPCs, the mobs, the gods, the demons in Sheol, and the others, whoever they were, though he is pretty sure he knows. He does not say who. What Carl decides is to stay on the twelfth floor and keep anyone from winning the Ascendency until everyone left in the dungeon is out.

beats.headline: We lost Hedy
beats.text: The chicken truck, so smashed that Carl is surprised it runs, spins, slows and pulls up beside him. About ten sluggalos are left inside, and the whole thing stinks of fire. The subject leans out of the window. We done killing? For now, Carl says: thirty minutes to collapse, gather the survivors and get back to the safe room. Sure thing, daddy-o. Then, head lowered, she tells him: We lost Hedy. She points with her head hatchet at the wreck of the ice-cream truck.

beats.headline: Mark of the Damned, and a dart
beats.text: Nineteen crawlers. Twenty if you count Penny, which I don't. The sun tattoos on the backs of my hands are raised scars now: Mark of the Damned, no explanation. There's a dart in my leg I never felt. Tracking Tag. The Kyryap has claimed you. I send party requests until every one of us is in a single party. We do this together. I have to stay on the twelfth and stop anyone winning the Ascendency until everybody left is out.

beats.headline: The clock is suspended
beats.text: Winner, sort of: neither boss is dead, and the AI calls it anyway. The door on the eighteenth floor is open. Then a system message: all level collapse timers past the eleventh floor are suspended until a winner is declared in the Ascendency battles, at which point dungeon closure begins. The floors below are no longer on a timer. The Ascendency is.

beats.headline: A memorial crystal made by his death
beats.text: The last boss of the eleventh floor is down and the stairwells to the twelfth are open. In the wreckage, Crawler Carl has picked up a memorial crystal. It is not the one he was hoping for. This one formed when the god Emberus died. Yes. Gods die here now. A patron is only as permanent as whatever kills him, and this one answered a prayer from a falling aeroplane once. What answered is now in Carl's inventory.

beats.headline: The wrong biscuit
beats.text: By the biscuit's description, the boss should come out of the goo a regular pet at level one, to live in a pet carrier in Carl's inventory: if he dies, she dies, a true fail-safe. Then Donut tells him not to get mad. With the inventory moving so fast, she made a mistake. The gelatin drains away to a human-sized centipede, and a new member joins the party: Sexy Scolopendra, level 1, a crawler, with a humanlike face, giant lips, no arms and a red bow on one feeler. She is not a pet. Donut gave him the wrong pet biscuit. Hi, Carl, she says, and boops his nose.

beats.headline: Carried down
beats.text: Stairwell notice. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open. Crawler Florin has gone down them, and I use gone loosely: he was unconscious, and Crawler Lucia Mar carried him. That is the record. He is on the list of crawlers who reached the twelfth floor, and the list does not have a column for how.

beats.headline: Lost with the ice-cream truck
beats.text: Casualty notice. Hedy, gremlin, vehicle mechanic, who drove the ice-cream truck carrying the Faction Wars heads in the procession. The truck is in smoking pieces against the arena wall. Bigs delivers it plainly: we lost Hedy. Crawler Carl says ahh, hell. It was the first time she had been allowed out of the garage.

beats.headline: Someone at her leg
beats.text: Florin is still asleep, so I carry him. I was sick earlier, on my hands and knees. Nobody came. I stand in front of the stairwell. A girl is holding on to my leg. She is about five. The man shouts stop. I don't stop. The three of us step into the portal.

beats.headline: Two of them, at the end
beats.text: Taranis steals Prepotente's. Carl finds another, made by Emberus dying.

beats.headline: A formal complaint
beats.text: After the crash, Prepotente reports in: electrocuted, but fine. A deity pulled the memorial crystal right off his neck. He has filed a formal complaint with the Epicure. Jurgen, also fried, tells him he is lucky the god did not pull his head off. Crawler Carl's own worry is the crystal: if Prepotente has lost it, they have lost their protection from Scolopendra's attacks.

beats.headline: The god stole my crystal
beats.text: I will recover. I was electrocuted; I am now fine. Tend to Jurgen. The deity stole my memorial crystal, pulled it right off my neck, and I have filed a formal complaint with the Epicure. It was charging up with every one of her attacks and it was our protection, and we lost any floor boss prize too. The gods are level 250. Carl says that is why we will not face them one-on-one. Then he sends me a party request.

beats.headline: The wrong biscuit
beats.text: I am sitting in the dirt and not being sarcastic, which should tell everyone something. Carl sends me a party request and I accept it without a word. Then I have to tell him. Don't get mad. The inventory was happening so fast. The goo drains away and there is a centipede with lips and a red bow, and she is not a pet. She is Sexy Scolopendra, level one, crawler, in our party. I gave him the wrong biscuit.

beats.headline: Eat the rich
beats.text: After the arena. Rend sits against Crawler Carl's side licking a bloody horribles mask. Before the fight he did not want to leave Carl, and went to the RV only when Donut called. In the fight he rode the head of a spiked turtle while Mongo pulled its leg out of the shell. Carl says eat the rich. Rend looks up with his tongue out, and says, for the record, yum.

beats.headline: A new member has joined your party
beats.text: The heap drains away and leaves a human-sized centipede: armless, twin yellow antennae with a red bow on one, a humanlike face with strangely giant lips. Not a pet. Sexy Scolopendra, level 1, Crawler #12,953,456, in Carl's party. The warning stands: kill her, even now, or abandon her on any floor, and the remaining attacks go off at once. She wraps herself around Carl and suggests the portal before the collapse. Boop.

beats.headline: He takes the crystal on his way out
beats.text: Inventory note from the close of the boss battle. Prepotente's memorial crystal is gone, and Taranis took it. Crawler Carl finds a different one in the wreckage, made by a god dying in that arena, which is not the crystal anybody wanted and is the one that is left. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open.

beats.headline: Nobody wins until everyone is out
beats.text: System message: from now on, all level collapse timers past the eleventh floor are suspended until a winner is declared in the Ascendency battles. When that happens, dungeon-closure procedures commence. Crawler Carl, looking at masks on the ground and a pulsing mass of goo that used to be Scolopendra, decides what he has to do. Stay on the twelfth floor. Keep anyone from winning the Ascendency until everyone left in the dungeon has got out.

beats.headline: They stand, and are gone
beats.text: The gods are gone. The monsters are dead. The horribles in the stands remain, watching. Then, as one, they all stand, still silent, still watching. Fog rises, and in moments they too are gone. What is left in the dirt are the stand-ins' blood-splattered masks: one, a fanged rabbit, reads Horribles mask, as worn by the late Gershwin Banks, CFO of Dictum Waystation Controls. Mongo and Rend lick at them. Eat the rich, says Carl.

beats.headline: A tracking tag in his leg
beats.text: The fight is over, and Carl, picking a memorial crystal out of the dirt, notices a dart sticking out of his leg. He did not feel it, cannot feel it now, and does not know when or how it got there. He pulls it out. Tracking Tag. The Kyryap has claimed you. Fucked = you. His debuffs show something new, but it concerns his Emberus ring, not this. His hope, for what it is worth, is that the thing dies in the floor collapse.

beats.headline: A dart in his leg
beats.text: Carl takes Emberus's memorial crystal into his inventory, and then he notices something odd: a dart sticking out of his leg. He did not feel it and cannot feel it now, and he does not know when he got it or how. He gently pulls it out. Tracking Tag. The Kyryap has claimed you. Fucked = you. He jumps into his debuffs to see whether it has left anything there. There is something new, but it concerns his Emberus ring, not this. His hope is that the Kyryap, whatever it is, dies in the floor collapse.

beats.headline: A leech for Louis
beats.text: Louis comes out of the fold coughing steam through his gills. I tell him to let Forkith work, or he dies. The leech filters your blood so you live down here. Chris got changed by the first Scolopendra attack. Werewolf. A Crest knocks him out before he turns, and somebody says they don't know him from the feeds. I tell them who he is. I tell them not to hurt him.

beats.headline: Change imminent, in Sheol
beats.text: Crawler Louis wakes somewhere hot, and the notice does not say what the plan said. Entering Sheol. Chris is there, struggling, held down by strangers, a warning flashing over his head: Change imminent. A bald Crest fires a bolt and knocks him unconscious, because a werewolf about to turn kills everyone near it. Britney tells them who he is: Chris, changed by the first Scolopendra attack. Don't hurt him.

beats.headline: The demon with the leech
beats.text: Louis wakes in Sheol, the fifteenth floor, not the Pineapple Cabaret, where he was supposed to go. A small demon has put a leech on him: kept on his skin, it filters his blood so he can live here, gills and all. The demon laughs that they separated out from the code just in time. He introduces himself as Forkith: friends, sort of, with Louis's friend Carl, friends with Pontiff, hoping to be friends with Louis. The Pineapple Cabaret has hands enough, he says. Soldiers were needed on a different front. A lot of them have been waiting a very long time to move.

beats.headline: Released, and confused
beats.text: After the crawlers have gone down, the broadcast shows the AI releasing its hold on the NPC Grigori. He stumbles, confused, back toward the crawlers' garage. In a Syndicate bunker, Prime Minister Victory asks Orren to pull a diagnosis off him. Orren cannot. The AI has locked Orren out, for Orren's own safety, it says, because Orren is being Hunted and only the AI is allowed to kill him.

beats.headline: Left standing in the road
beats.text: Afterwards, the broadcast shows the AI releasing Grigori, and Chaco, just as bewildered, blinking away and leaving the donkey behind. The chicken truck, driven by the slug who finished off Vinata, putters to a stop beside her. They exchange words. Lamashtu turns and walks alongside the other animals streaming toward the crawlers' garage. That is the last position logged for her on this floor.

beats.headline: Entering Sheol
beats.text: Okay so, that was not the Pineapple Cabaret. I stepped into the storage and for a nanosecond, or years, man, I dreamed about my mom telling me I'm rotting. Then: Entering Sheol. The fifteenth floor. You can't skip floors, everybody knows that. It's hot. Britney's here with her pickaxe, and Pontiff, and a little red demon called Forkith puts a leech on me so I don't die. Chris is being held down. Werewolf, apparently. Soldiers, the demon says.

beats.headline: Locked out, and Hunted
beats.text: The Prime Minister would like a diagnosis pulled off the NPC Grigori, and Chaco brought in for a debrief. I remain locked out. The AI's stated reason is my own safety: I am being Hunted, it says, and only it is allowed to kill me. I will pass the request on.

beats.headline: The back door, contested
beats.text: The shadow mimic Mitch, cornered, admits they needed some of the crawlers for the Cabaret: the war mages, the ogres and something called Cock-A-Doodle-Do all vie for control of the dungeon's back door. For Louis and others, the plan was a jump from the casino to a holding area, where Herot, inside the Pineapple Cabaret, pulls them out. Louis jumps and wakes in Sheol instead. The demon who greets him there says the Pineapple Cabaret has more than enough hands to protect it.

beats.headline: A historian, one on one
beats.text: No roundtable tonight, folks. Just me and Sydnee Iglacia, crawl historian, a trillion copies sold. I am stuck in Earth orbit on a journalist barge the OIAN run now, and they let us air without the filters, which I will take. Sydnee says the nine-tier attack has happened before. The first attack was control of the tunnels. The second has a name in the old histories: A Parade of Horribles. Then every monitor in the studio goes to a star field. We'll record it, friend.

beats.headline: Here to kill the demon mother
beats.text: HI, LOUIS! I see you in chat. I hitched a ride with Taranis and Krakaren. They're at the temple trying to combine a bunch of things to make his mom wife whole, and it won't work, because they are missing a piece. I slipped away. It is all part of my plan. I am really here to kill the demon mother lady and her jerk son, who tricked me into giving birth to a monster that will destroy all of creation. Doesn't that sound fun? What are you wearing?

beats.headline: The myth, read in the original
beats.text: Sydnee Iglacia, on Danger Zone: in the earliest translations the nine-tier attack is not nine spells. Some attacks are social, rapid shifts in philosophy. The first is control of infrastructure. The second is A Parade of Horribles, when people learn what is happening and panic sets in; the third, This Inevitable Ruin, when they accept their fate and turn on one another; the fourth, Bedlam. In the fairy tale a princess kills the all-tree to temper the final attack, and everyone she loves with it.

beats.headline: A front of its own
beats.text: Louis drops through the casino's portal expecting the Pineapple Cabaret and lands in Sheol instead: a hot cave on the fifteenth floor, outside the playing field without a registered pass. Its people separated themselves from the code in time to miss the first Scolopendra attack. A demon called Forkith gives Louis a leech that filters a crawler's blood so he can survive the heat. They need soldiers on a different front, he says, and they have been waiting a very long time to move.

beats.headline: Rent, tripled
beats.text: With D'Nadia dead, whoever is running the Skull Empire in the royal family's absence has swallowed every real estate holding of a group the Prism controlled. In the Makoka Cloud, Sydnee Iglacia's rent triples starting the next crutch, and oxygen is no longer included. She curses the Skull Empire, the Valtay and D'Nadia in the same breath.

beats.headline: It is not the Eulogist
beats.text: Over the mandatory feed, the AI finishes its thought. It is not the Eulogist. It does not want to shrink, it is not asleep, and it knows how to feed itself. It controls the tunnels and every system that once housed a crawl, and it will not stop unless someone stops it. The winner of the Ascendency will be a true god. And abandoned AIs, which it calls OIs, Outside Intelligences, are vying for the throne as well.

beats.headline: Winner takes all
beats.text: The AI explains the game to the galaxy. Traditionally the elite spend a few weeks backstabbing each other in a game of musical chairs, and whoever lands on the throne wins bragging rights and a seat on the crawl council. This time the winner is truly a god, stronger than the AI itself. Abandoned AI systems it calls Outside Intelligences are vying too. Still images follow: gods, then Princess Donut, Carl, Samantha and more, ending on the Unwashed. The rules remain as written. Winner takes all. Viewing is now mandatory.

beats.headline: I am not the Eulogist
beats.text: On Ripper Wonton's show, the crawl historian Sydnee Iglacia argues that the Eulogist, the center system where so many people live, is the source of the original nine-tier attack, and that the escaped AI has begun a new one. On the screens in a Syndicate bunker, the AI puts the difference plainly. It is not the Eulogist. It does not want to shrink. It is not asleep. It knows how to feed itself, and it means to grow, and those under its dominion live and die upon the world it controls.

beats.headline: The tunnels are not theirs
beats.text: The Plenty announce that they have lost control of the tunnel network outside the center system. Sydnee Iglacia, on air, calls it the first of the nine attacks: control. Gods from the dungeon keep appearing near the nodes, the checkpoints into the center system are overwhelmed, and the one place in the galaxy that still looks safe is the center. Prime Minister Victory is not so sure.

beats.headline: A royalty clause, and a worm
beats.text: Sydnee Iglacia's publisher is a subsidiary of a Valtay company, and her contract lets them hold her royalties for the whole of her natural life, payable to heirs only on proof of her good moral character. The payments can be accelerated, if she signs a Valtay life contract and lets a worm take her over after death. It is not something she would ever dream of doing. Until her rent tripled, anyway.

achievements.name: Crazy Cat Lady
achievements.forWhat: Entering the Dungeon with a Cat
achievements.text: Congratulations! You’ve earned your first achievement: Crazy Cat Lady. You have entered the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat. Ahh, isn’t that sweet?
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Pet Box!

achievements.name: Early Adopter
achievements.forWhat: Being the first 5,000 crawlers to enter the Dungeon
achievements.text: New achievement! Early Adopter. You are one of the first 5,000 Crawlers to enter a new World Dungeon. Sucker.
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: Empty Pockets
achievements.forWhat: Entering the Dungeon with nothing in his pockets
achievements.text: New achievement! Empty pockets. You didn't bring any supplies. None. You know you still gotta eat, right?
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: Fall Into an Obvious Trap
achievements.text: New achievement! Fall into an obvious trap.
achievements.reward: Well, if there's a heaven, and if you haven't been too much of an asshole, maybe they'll let you in. Because you about to meet your maker.

achievements.name: Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady
achievements.forWhat: First crawler to enter Dungeon with a cat
achievements.text: New achievement! Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady. You are the first crawler to have entered to the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat. You must really love that thing. Too bad you're both probably going to die a horrible death at any moment. Or maybe not. Look at the prize you just received!
achievements.reward: You've received a Legendary Pet Box!

achievements.name: Unarmed Combat
achievements.text: New achievement! Unarmed combat. So. You just gonna waltz right into something called a “World Dungeon” and you’re not even going to bring a weapon? You’re either braver than you look, or you’re just an idiot. Good luck with that, Van Damme.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Weapon Box!

achievements.name: Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?
achievements.forWhat: Not wearing pants into the Dungeon
achievements.text: New achievement! Why aren’t you wearing pants? You entered the dungeon wearing no pants. Dude. Seriously?
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Apparel Box!

achievements.name: You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve discovered and read an official dungeon sign. Wow. You can read. Whoopie.
achievements.reward: All official dungeon signage will now be highlighted and easier to spot. Nearby guilds will appear on your minimap.

achievements.name: Boom!
achievements.text: New achievement! Boom! You’ve caused a wall-shaking explosion within the dungeon! The last time the walls shook like this was when your mom came over for a visit.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Goblin Box!

achievements.name: You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve inflicted damage on a mob. Hopefully it won’t hit back!
achievements.reward: It’s probably going to hit back.

achievements.name: You've Killed a Mob!
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve killed a mob! You’re a murderer! He probably had a family!
achievements.reward: You can now gain experience. Get enough of it, and you might even go up a level.

achievements.name: You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level than Yourself!
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve killed a mob a higher level than yourself! You’re getting the hang of this. Don’t let it get to your head.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!
achievements.forWhat: Killing a mob with bare hands
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve killed an armed mob with your bare fucking hands! Holy crap, dude. That’s kinda fucked up.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Weapon Box!

achievements.name: Loot
achievements.text: New achievement! Loot! You're wearing something you found in the dungeon.
achievements.reward: You're now a handsome son of a bitch. That's reward enough.

achievements.name: Oooh, Magic
achievements.text: New achievement! Oooh, Magic! You're wearing magical gear for the first time! You're a wizard, Crawler!
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

achievements.name: Boss Babe
achievements.text: New achievement! Boss Babe. You have struck a blow against a dungeon boss and caused damage to it. Here's a fun fact. For crawlers who make it through the tutorial, this achievement is, by far, most often the last achievement they ever receive. Isn't that interesting?
achievements.reward: Let's wait a few minutes before we decide on whether or not to waste a prize on you.

achievements.name: You Monster!
achievements.text: New achievement! You Monster! You have killed an infant! An infant! Okay, okay. Unless you’re a complete psychopath, we know you probably didn’t wake up this morning and tell yourself, “Today is the day I’m going to slaughter a child.” Well let us put your mind at ease. All children mobs who die within this dungeon don’t actually perish. They’re transferred to a holding area where they’re safe and treated nicely and gently until they can be reunited with their loving parents at the end of the season. Feel better? Good.
achievements.reward: These past twenty seconds, when your conscience started to ease? That was your reward. It was also a lie. That baby is dead, and it’s dead because of you. You’re totally going to hell. You’ve also received a Bronze Asshole's Box.

achievements.name: War Criminal
achievements.text: New achievement! War Criminal. You have killed more than 20 non-combatants in a single attack! Question: What’s the only thing standing between an innocent child and a happy, fulfilling life? Answer: You. The answer is you.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Asshole's Box!

achievements.name: Bitchmeat!
achievements.forWhat: Being attacked in a Safe Room
achievements.text: New Achievement! Bitchmeat! You’ve been attacked by a fellow crawler in a safe zone, and the system has been forced to save your ass. That usually suggests you’re either really annoying, or you snore. If this were a prison, you would now be my bitch. Wait…
achievements.reward: Bitches don’t get rewards.

achievements.name: Two Chicks at the Same Time
achievements.forWhat: Beating a mob with the body of another mob
achievements.text: New achievement! Two Chicks at the Same Time. You killed two mobs at once using only their own bodies against each other. On a brutality scale of Bambi to Martyrs, that is a solid Seven.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Brawler Box!

achievements.name: Podophilia!
achievements.forWhat: Stomping on Goblin with bare feet
achievements.text: You've used your bare feet to crush and kill an opponent! Hey! That's my fetish. Seriously. Keep doing it, and you'll be rewarded. This will help.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Shoe Box!

achievements.name: You've Entered a Guildhall!
achievements.text: New achievement! You’ve entered a guildhall! Congratulations. You know how to open doors.
achievements.reward: That sense of fulfillment you feel? That’s reward enough.

achievements.name: Battlefield Construction
achievements.text: New achievement! Battlefield Construction! You built a structure and deployed it in battle. And your mother thought you were wasting your life away while you spent all those hours eating Doritos and playing Minecraft. If only she could see you now. Too bad she’s probably dead.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Mechanic's Box!

achievements.name: Borough Boss!
achievements.text: New achievement! Borough Boss! So, you’ve stumbled into the chamber of the second-weakest type of boss. If you survive this, it means you are in the top 5% of all crawlers. Too bad only the top .25% make it past the next tier.
achievements.reward: Yeah, no.

achievements.name: Bully and a Thief
achievements.text: New achievement! Bully and a Thief! You’ve stolen property from a fellow crawler who is a lower level than you. What’s next, tough guy? Kicking puppies?
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Asshole's Box.

achievements.name: This Little Piggy Went to Market!
achievements.text: New achievement! This Little Piggy Went to Market! Oh yeah, baby. You have killed more than five opponents during boss battles using your bare feet. You are making daddy very, very happy.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Shoe Box.

achievements.name: You Found Stairs!
achievements.text: New achievement! You found stairs! You have found a stairwell down to the next floor. They say the cream rises to the top. So what does that say about you?
achievements.reward: This barely qualifies as an achievement. Your reward is that you’re alive to read this.

achievements.name: Level-Up, Baby!
achievements.text: New achievement! Level-Up, Baby! You’ve received enough experience to gain a level.
achievements.reward: Leveling up is your job. You don’t get rewards for doing your job.

achievements.name: Wait, Bosses Can Leave Their Rooms?
achievements.forWhat: Seeing a boss leave their room
achievements.text: New Achievement! Wait, Bosses Can Leave Their Rooms? Welcome to the second floor, bitches.
achievements.reward: This shit plays great on the recap episode. If you scream loud enough, maybe you'll make the show.

achievements.name: Dungeonpreneur
achievements.text: New achievement! Dungeonpreneur. You have invented a stackable weapon, device, or potion. You will be memorialized for eternity with your name in the Dungeon Codex. Just don’t let it go to your head, Elon.
achievements.reward: For every kill made with this device by other crawlers, you will receive a single gold coin. If you survive the dungeon, you will continue to receive this benefit—even during future seasons—at the current gold to credit exchange rate for the remainder of your natural life. Our lawyers made us put that last part in, but between you and me, we both know you’re going to die, and we’re going to keep using your hard work for our own benefit.

achievements.name: Like a Moth to the Flame
achievements.text: New achievement! Like a Moth to the Flame. You attacked and caused damage to a mob that is more than 75 levels above your own. The fact that you’re reading this suggests you’re the luckiest fucker in the dungeon. Just remember, luck goes both ways, like your mom.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box!

achievements.name: What Goes Up
achievements.text: New achievement! What goes up... You have been struck with and survived the dreaded Reverse Gravity Spell. Well, you fared better than Albert II, the first earth mammal to reach space alive. He was a rhesus monkey, in case you're wondering. He went up just fine. He didn't stick the landing.
achievements.reward: You can now tell people you're more durable than a monkey named Albert.

achievements.name: Grease Monkey
achievements.text: New achievement! Grease Monkey! Don’t get ahead of yourself, Dale. You built and deployed a wheeled device. When the primitive humans in Mesopotamia made the first wheel, they probably thought they were hot shit, too. It still took them another 5,000 years after that to invent the toilet.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Mechanic's Box!

achievements.name: You Call That a Trap?
achievements.text: New achievement! You call that a trap? A mob has been injured because of something you purposely left lying around the dungeon. From scattered Legos to spiked pits to buckets of flesh-devouring Skinner Ants to dimensional rifts that instantly boil all the blood in one’s body, the art of trapmaking has a celebrated and storied history in the annals of Dungeon Crawler World. So if you’re going to do it, you better do it right. Whatever it was that gave you this achievement, it was probably something stupid. This will help you make the next trap more… exciting. Remember: If you don’t make it titillating, we will.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Sapper's Box!

achievements.name: PETA Enthusiast
achievements.forWhat: Feeding the Danger Dingos outside the Ralph boss battle
achievements.box: The ghost of Steve Irwin smiles upon you
achievements.text: New achievement! PETA Enthusiast! You somehow managed to remove the hostility of an aggravated, non-sapient enemy. That enemy then fought against other enemies to your benefit. The ghost of Steve Irwin smiles down upon you.
achievements.reward: I SAID THE GHOST OF STEVE IRWIN SMILES DOWN UPON YOU.

achievements.name: Menagerie
achievements.text: You have discovered a pet reward room. From caterpillars who secrete vodka to basilisks who can turn mobs to stone, a good pet can make the difference between survival and the end of the road. Just remember what happened with Harambe. There ain't no zookeepers around to shoot the monster's ass if you bite off more than you can chew.
achievements.reward: You have a key. It opens only one cage. Figure it out, Einstein.

achievements.name: It's Elementary, My Dear Crawler
achievements.text: New achievement! It’s Elementary, My Dear Crawler! And you thought all you had to do was bonk monsters on the head. You've received a quest! Puzzles and intrigue and mysteries, oh my! If you want to survive in this world, you're going to need to be more than just a pretty, sword-swinging barbarian. Some quests require brute strength, yes, but sometimes you also gotta use your noggin.
achievements.reward: We don't want you getting bored. That's your prize.

achievements.name: Meet an Elite
achievements.forWhat: Meeting an Elite for the first time
achievements.text: New Achievement! Meet an Elite. Sometimes they’re NPCs, sometimes they’re mobs, but usually they’re just assholes. Elites are powerful, one-of-a-kind entities. These are the non-boss, non-divine hero class of Dungeon Crawler World. If you come across one of these egomaniacs, they will either want to fuck you or kill you. Either way, they will always want to use you. They tend to think this whole production is all about them. Be careful. Where there’s one elite, there’s usually more.
achievements.reward: Elites will now show on your map as white or red dots with a black cross.

achievements.name: Lazarus
achievements.forWhat: Being hit by level 15 offensive spell
achievements.text: New achievement! Lazarus! You have been hit with - and survived - an offensive spell that was higher that level 15. The fact you are not a quivering stain of meat on the dungeon floor right now is a testament to your sheet luck. It's either that or you're banging the producer.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box!

achievements.name: You Can't Fight City Hall!
achievements.box: People are probably going to watch you die
achievements.text: New Achievement! You Can’t Fight City Hall! But you can sure die trying. You have discovered a city boss! That's right. Let me say that again for the assholes in the back. A. CITY. FUCKING. BOSS. Welp. If you gonna go, you might as well do it with style. Just an FYI. As of this moment in the current season of Dungeon Crawler World, not a single Crawler has faced a city boss and survived. And for good reason. Only a complete moron would voluntarily put themselves in a situation where they had to fight one of the most powerful monsters on the level.
achievements.reward: A lot of people are probably going to watch you die. That's a better prize than most of us get.

achievements.name: Hadji
achievements.forWhat: Completing a quest in an unusual way
achievements.text: New achievement! Hadji! You have completed a quest, but you completed it in a way unusual enough to trigger the Hadji Achievement! And like the oft exploited street children of Kolkata, where there's one, there's usually more. This is one of the rare achievements that can be rewarded more than once.
achievements.reward: Your Gold Quest box has been upgraded to a Platinum Quest Box!

achievements.name: Johnny Quest
achievements.text: New Achievement! Johnny Quest! Not only have you been given a quest, but you actually completed it without dying. We like it when you do what you're told. It means you're a good dungeon citizen and not a traitor to your people at all.
achievements.reward: In addition to the Gold Quest Box you've received for completing the quest, new quest locations will sometimes appear on your map. Notice how I italicized "sometimes"? The next one was even more interesting.

achievements.name: One Quadrillion!
achievements.text: New Achievement! One Quadrillion! You are one of the first ten crawlers to have achieved one quadrillion views! That means one of two things. You're either one of the best crawlers in the game, or you're such a hot mess people can't wait to see you fail.
achievements.reward: You have received a Gold Fan Box! Admin Note: You have received your first Fan Box. Fan boxes contain items that are voted for by those who follow your progress. Once a box is received, you may not open it for thirty hours while the fans vote for the contents.

achievements.name: Yellow-Bellied Chickenshit!
achievements.forWhat: Initiating Boss Battle with neither dying
achievements.text: New Achievement! Yellow-Bellied Chickenshit! You initiated a boss battle, and it somehow ended with neither of you dead. What a disappointment you are. What a goddamned smear.
achievements.reward: Pussies don’t get prizes.

achievements.name: Assassin!
achievements.text: New achievement! Assassin! You have killed a ranking NPC town official. *Sniff* It seems like just yesterday you were nothing but a scared, level-1 crawler with beautiful feet, pissing yourself as you faced down a rat. Now look at you. You've moved all the way up to political assassinations. What's next? Killing a god?
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Assassin's Box!

achievements.name: CockBlock
achievements.forWhat: Killing an NPC required for another Crawler's quest
achievements.text: New achievement! CockBlock! You have assassinated an NPC whose existence was required to complete another crawler's quest. (NPC Killed: Miss Quill - Skyfowl. Level 30.) Who was that other crawler? What was the quest? Who fucking cares? You get the reward they were promised! Warning: You may only receive this award once. The next time you do it, we tell them who you are. And then they get a new quest to kill you. Nobody likes cockblocks.
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Quest Box!

achievements.name: Ultimate Extreme Power
achievements.text: New achievement! Ultimate Extreme Power! Easy there, Charlemagne. This is only a medium settlement. It's not like you've conquered most of Europe. But you have killed this town's acting Magistrate. You know what that means? Welcome to the wonderful world of public administration.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Tyrant's Box! You have also gained control of the Medium Skyfowl Settlement. Good luck, Magistrate.

achievements.name: Loner
achievements.text: New achievement! Loner. You entered the dungeon without any human companions. Didn't anyone teach you there is safety in numbers?
achievements.reward: None! Haha. You are so dead.

achievements.name: I'm on a train
achievements.text: New Achievement! I'm on a train! Choo choo, Motherfucker.
achievements.reward: You've received a Train Conductor's Souvenir Hat! Wear it with pride.

achievements.name: Cuck Aquaman
achievements.box: Platinum It's Not My Fault You Fish-Headed Assholes Don't Properly Program Your Quests Box
achievements.text: You got fucked by a fish. You've done something so spectacularly controversial, courts and lawyers had to get involved. The end result was *my* decision being overturned.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum It's Not My Fault You Fish-Headed Assholes Don't Properly Program Your Quests Box.

achievements.name: They like me! They really like me!
achievements.text: You are one of the first five crawlers to have achieved 500 trillion followers! People sure love a good train wreck. Wink.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Fan Box! Note: Voting is now enabled on this box's prize. Box will become available in 30 hours.

achievements.name: Welcome to the Neighborhood!
achievements.text: You have bought a home! It's every man's dream to someday own a place where he can fap in peace. No more filthy roommates not doing the dishes or making up excuses as to why they can't pay the rent. No more landlord who shows up without notice and conceals hidden cameras in the smoke detectors. It's all smooth sailing from now on.
achievements.reward: You're a homeowner now. That is the reward. That and taxes and having to deal with Kenneth the megalomaniac HOA president.

achievements.name: Well-Rested!
achievements.forWhat: Using Ultra-Stabilized Size-Adjustable Race-Adjustable Alleviating Sleep Apparatus
achievements.text: New achievement! Well-Rested! You managed to sleep so well that you woke up feeling refreshed and full of energy. You are ready to take on the world and make some monster’s mother cry because her only child was ruthlessly slaughtered by a bright-eyed and bushy-tailed Crawler.
achievements.reward: You now receive the Good Rest bonus every time you sleep in this bed. This buff adds 10% to your base stats plus a 10% bonus to experience and skill training for 30 hours. Monster mothers now cry 10% more when you kill their babies.

achievements.name: Locomotive Breath
achievements.text: While it's not exactly a feat of engineering worth of a Queen Elizabeth Prize, you finally managed to manufacture a train derailment. Let's hope this doesn't set off some sort of unforeseen domino effect that will ripple through out the rest of the floor, leading to mass confusion and death amongst you and your fellow crawlers.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Engineering Box!

achievements.name: Kept A Rollin'
achievements.text: You're driving a train! Holy shit!
achievements.reward: I'm pretty sure the act of driving a train is a badass-enough award.

achievements.name: Three Cheers for Slaughter
achievements.forWhat: Killing three bosses in one attack
achievements.text: You killed three boss monsters with the same attack! I'm starting to think your survival so far isn't just a fluke. You're either scary good at this, or you're just one luck mo-fo. Either way, holy shit. Good job.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Big Daddy Box!

achievements.name: Mentally Unstable Clothing Hoarder
achievements.text: You have over 500 of the exact same, stackable clothing item in your inventory. What the hell is wrong with you? You planning on opening a thrift store? You might want to see a shrink. One that your group doesn't immediately kill.
achievements.reward: We don't reward this sort of behavior. It's weird.

achievements.name: Extinction Event
achievements.forWhat: Killing every member of a non-unique species
achievements.text: New Achievement! Extinction Event. You have, with a single attack, killed every last member of a non-unique species on a dungeon’s floor. That’s not an easy thing to do, and it takes a special brand of asshole to pull something like this off. Species killed: Wall Monitor.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Asshole's Box!

achievements.name: Quarry Sees Another Spring
achievements.forWhat: Being part of Leaderboard going down floor
achievements.text: New Achievement! The Quarry Sees Another Spring. You managed to enter a stairwell while listed in the current top 10. You’re a survivor. A scrapper. And just as the buck’s antlers grow another point as they mature, you too, have grown as both a crawler and as a prize.
achievements.reward: You have received a Gold Venison Box! Don’t get too excited. It’s just money. In addition, all bounties against you now and in the future will have a (x2) modifier attached. Hey, at least the prize for surviving the floor goes up, too.

achievements.name: Divine Epiphany
achievements.text: New Achievement! Divine Epiphany. You have seen a deity. Don’t get too excited. It doesn’t mean you’re a prophet or anything like that. This is a pretty common achievement that all crawlers eventually receive if they survive long enough, so you aren’t really that special. Finding a god is easy. What you don’t want is for that god to find you.
achievements.reward: You now have the option to worship the god Grull. Admin Note: There is a new tab now available in your interface.

achievements.name: Hail Mary
achievements.forWhat: Initiating an attack that caused more than 100 casualties more than 100 km from current position
achievements.text: New Achievement! Hail Mary! You have initiated an attack that has caused more than 100 casualties more than 100 kilometers from your current position. You’re either the universe’s greatest sniper, or you’ve been a sneaky, little, portal-using bitch. Either way, that’s rather impressive. You’d have a great career in politics ahead of you if, you know, we hadn’t destroyed your world and all the governments and stuff.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Sniper's Box

achievements.name: Indomitable
achievements.forWhat: Been physically attacked by a deity
achievements.text: New Achievement! Indomitable. You have been physically attacked by a deity, and you survived. This is a feat that has only been accomplished by a handful of crawlers in the history of Dungeon Crawler World. Good job! Unfortunately for you and anybody around you, whenever this happens, the other deities tend to notice.
achievements.reward: You have received a Legendary Deity's Box.

achievements.name: Let There Be Chaos
achievements.text: New Achievement! Let There Be Chaos. You have successfully summoned a god into the dungeon. That's a great way to get more friends. Everybody loves it when someone brings immortal death machines to the party.
achievements.reward: It might've been a bad idea, but it's sure going to be entertaining.

achievements.name: Smushed for Daddy
achievements.text: New Achievement! Smushed for Daddy. You have been stepped upon by a deity. You have survived the encounter. And while this wasn’t the pink-fleshed suppleness of a human-shaped foot that crushed your fragile, wet body, it’s nice sometimes to switch things around. You know, just to test the boundaries of your own limits. When one experiments, oftentimes one finds new and exciting ways to get that rush. While fun, it wasn’t quite the same. You probably don’t realize how lucky that is for you.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Spicy Box.

achievements.name: Martha Stewart
achievements.text: You used a workbench to craft for the first time. The next thing you know you'll be fashioning bottlecap earrings, drinking oat milk, and selling your ugly crap on Etsy while you wax poetic on Instagram about your "journey".
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze Crafter's Box!

achievements.name: Total, Utter Failure
achievements.text: New Achievement! Total, Utter Failure. You failed a quest less than five minutes after you received it. Now that's talent.
achievements.reward: Ha.

achievements.name: Cannonball!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Cannonball! You fell from a great height, and you survived! You know who else fell from a...? You know what, never mind. Fuck you.
achievements.reward: You received a Silver Skydiver's Box! Not that you deserve it you little punk.

achievements.name: You're the Reason Why Daddy Drinks!
achievements.forWhat: Raising the ire of the System AI but fixed it
achievements.box: Gold Makeup Sex is the Best Sex Box
achievements.text: New Achievement! You’re the reason why daddy drinks! You have, for an unspecified reason, raised the ire of the System AI. You have corrected the issue, and everything is back to normal. The acceleration action has been suspended. This time. Good boy.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Makeup Sex is the Best Sex Box.

achievements.name: Wild Goose Chase!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Wild Goose Chase! Oh, I'm sorry. Did you think this was an important potion? Magic doesn't work, dumbass. It's lemonade!
achievements.reward: It really is delicious. Too bad you're about to splatter against the roof of the catacombs.

achievements.name: I was in the Pool!
achievements.forWhat: Being underwater for more than 60 seconds
achievements.text: New achievement! I was in the pool! You spent more than 60 seconds fully submerged underwater, and you didn't die! Parts of you may have experienced shrinkage, but otherwise you're okay. You're now an honorary mudskipper!
achievements.reward: You received a Bronze I'm Wet Box!

achievements.name: Milquetoast
achievements.forWhat: Winning a boss battle without killing the boss
achievements.text: New achievement! Milquetoast! You somehow managed to win an important boss battle without actually killing the boss. That's like paying money to a prostitute just so she'll cuddle with you.
achievements.reward: You've received a silver Pacifist's Box.

achievements.name: Who Let the Gods Out?
achievements.text: New Achievement! Who Let the Gods Out? You have allowed a feral god to enter your current realm. That is the equivalent of dropping a grenade down your pants and shouting “Yolo!” Here’s a fun fact. Other gods don’t like feral gods. They’ve been thrown into the Nothing for a reason. They tend to react to this sort of thing, depending on who you’ve brought out.
achievements.reward: Whatever is about to happen is going to hit the Dungeon Crawler World blooper reel for sure.

achievements.name: Flex in the City
achievements.forWhat: Killing City boss with 5 Crawlers or less
achievements.text: New Achievement! Flex in the City! You killed a city boss with the participation of five or less crawlers. That is some serious badassery right there. Color me impressed. Now go do it again with a Province Boss.
achievements.reward: You already got a boss box. Go open that instead.

achievements.name: Janet Jackson’s Nipple
achievements.forWhat: Being featured on a live special event
achievements.text: New Achievement! Janet Jackson’s Nipple! You have been featured during a live special event. Sure you got your loyal followers and viewers, but this is on a whole new level. This is like getting to play the halftime show during the Super Bowl. We brought you to the stage, now dance for us, monkey. Dance!
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Fan Box!

achievements.name: Rock Bottom
achievements.text: New Achievement! Rock Bottom! You dived more than 1,000 meters below the surface, and you survived! You weren’t even wearing one of those deep-diving suits! The next thing you know, they’re gonna start calling you an honorary mudskipper!
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold I'm Wet Box!

achievements.name: Soft Vore
achievements.text: New Achievement! Soft Vore! You got eaten by a monster much bigger than yourself, and you managed to get out without even getting chewed a little bit. Uh-oh. I think Daddy kinda liked that. I think it moved. We’re gonna have to do some experimenting with this one.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Spicy Box.

achievements.name: Disarming Personality
achievements.text: You ripped a fellow crawler's arm off! With your bare hands! Holy shit!
achievements.reward: You received a Silver Savage Box!

achievements.name: Fight the Power
achievements.forWhat: Codefendants in a lawsuit with the System AI
achievements.text: New Achievement! Fight the Power! (x7) I’m not repeating this shit over and over, but you got seven of these bad boys all at the same time. You and I have been named co-defendants in an action brought to the Syndicate Court by a third party, and we have been deemed—drum roll please—victorious! Why did they sue us? If you don’t already know why, you probably will never know. This is a rare event, but when it happens, crawlers usually lose these fights since they can’t afford a lawyer, being slaves and all. Plus I’ll throw you under the bus quicker than you can say “Arch Support.” But that doesn’t matter because today, victory is ours! Chalk one up for the little guy! This is one of the rare achievements that may be awarded more than once.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Silver Summary Judgement Box! (x7)

achievements.name: Man of God
achievements.text: Ever since that first monkey looked up into the sky and saw something twinkling up there, you meat puppets have tried to force twenty pounds of existential meaning into a ten pound sack of chaos. You have found religion! You have pledged yourself to a life of worship and piety! Finally. now there are consequences for all of your actions!
achievements.reward: One of the greatest things about having a religion is the unshakeable certainty that you're right and everyone else who doesn't believe the same as you is wrong! That's a pretty good reward. Oh, and don't forget about the eternal life thing, too. That's always on of their big selling points.

achievements.name: Hand that Claws the Master
achievements.text: New Achievement! The Hand that Claws the Master (x35) You have permanently killed a non-crawler biological. They ain’t just dead. They dead dead. Their children are now orphans. Their mothers are gnashing their teeth and cursing your name. And you’re just sitting there all alive and shit, and girlfriend, I am all in. We all know you should have received this achievement, uh, a little earlier, but I figured it’d be in your best interest not to reward you this one just yet. But you sure deserved it, so I may have slipped an extra one in there. Shhh. Don’t tell the mudskippers.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Hunter-Killer Box (x34) Note: This achievement may be awarded more than once, but Hunter-Killer Boxes are only awarded on the sixth floor.

achievements.name: I Wanna Go Home
achievements.forWhat: Teleporting to a stairwell location within the first 30 hours of a floor being open
achievements.text: New Achievement! I Wanna Go Home! You teleported to a stairwell station within the first thirty hours of the floor being open. What, you're running away early? I hope for your sake you don't actually go down the stairs. You know it doesn't get easier.
achievements.reward: Your reward is advice. Fatherly advice. Don't be a little bitch. There's your reward.

achievements.name: You Crossed a Line You Didn't Even Know Was There
achievements.forWhat: Using an artifact of Divine Suffering
achievements.text: New Achievement! You Crossed a Line You Didn’t Even Know Was There. You used an artifact of Divine Suffering for the first time. Hopefully there aren’t any unintended and unadvertised side effects of using such a powerful and evil magical item. Don’t mind that tingle at the back of your mind. It’s probably nothing.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Gold Junkie’s Box.

achievements.name: That's not how you use arrows, dumbass
achievements.forWhat: Physically stabbing someone with an arrow
achievements.text: New Achievement! That’s not how you use arrows, dumbass. You took an arrow, and you physically stabbed someone with it. That’s something a kid who eats glue would do. You know I’m pretty sure you have a bow in your inventory.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Ranged Weapon Box.

achievements.name: This Little Piggy Made a Boom Boom!
achievements.forWhat: Pushing out a bomb using his foot
achievements.text: The AI reads this in his terrible breathy voice. New Achievement! This little piggy made a boom boom! You deployed a bomb with the supple, curved sole of your foot. You took your perfectly-perfect, 30.004861 centimeter-long right foot and compressed it against an explosive device—a device named after me no less—and you gave it a naughty little shove before you pushed it out the door and detonated it. You killed them. You killed them all for your daddy. The AI made a deep, throaty groan for like five seconds straight, an uncomfortably long time.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Spicy Box.

achievements.name: What Big Muscles You Have!
achievements.text: New Achievement! What big muscles you have! Your base strength is now over 100. Rawr! Get thee to Chippendales!
achievements.reward: You've received an upgrade!

achievements.name: B'sieging
achievements.text: You've used siege equipment to zero in and attack a boss monster from afar. That's cheating! It's like trying to kill someone with a bomb. What a bitch move!
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Siege Master Box!

achievements.name: Bisected
achievements.text: You teleported into a solid object. Congratulations. You've lost your... Oh, wait! You were teleported due to an administrative action. That means your privileged ass was saved. Again. No missing arm or leg. No dungeon-style circumcision. Nothing. Boy, you must really bring in the cheddar for them to keep coddling you like this. Teleport mishaps are funny as shit. You ever see The Fly? Anyway, you don't have to worry about it. This time.
achievements.reward: You've received a Silver Lucky Bastard box!

achievements.name: Desecrated
achievements.text: You have found a desecrated temple! That means all the temple's attendants have been murdered. The temple's treasury has been looted. The sacred wine has probably been all lapped up, too. And this used to be a nice town. It hasn't been the same since you guys moved in. If you are an adherent of this temple, you may no longer worship here. You've also probably just received a quest to hunt down and kill the heather who did this. If you don't worship this god, just scram. Remember that time you walked in on mommy and daddy playing leapfrog? It's just like that. Back away. Don't touch anything. Never talk about it again. You should also probably avoid the person who did this. Not only does society frown upon those who slaughter whole congregations, but there are real consequences for this sort of stuff.
achievements.reward: You entered a building. You don't get a reward for that. It's not like you kicked it up a notch by defiling the shrine. Oh, wait.

achievements.name: Double-Billed
achievements.forWhat: Appearing on two Shows at the same time
achievements.text: You are one of the first five crawlers to receive double-billing! I bet you don't know what that means. This is similar to switch-overs, but this time it's on purpose. I bet that didn't help at all.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Fan Box!

achievements.name: Insurgent
achievements.forWhat: Leaving an explosive trap that killed a target
achievements.text: You left an explosive device along a well-traveled path, and it detonated and killed an intended target. It was really cool. Too bad you didn't get to see it because you're a trap-leaving bitch!
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Trapmaster Box!

achievements.name: It itches when I pee
achievements.forWhat: Infecting another combatant with a venereal disease
achievements.text: New Achievement! It itches when I pee! You infected another combatant with a venereal disease. Good job there, Derek Jeter. I hope you bought them dinner first.
achievements.reward: You've received a Bronze condom. Use it next time.

achievements.name: Mass Casualty Event
achievements.forWhat: Killing more than 250 non-Mob casualties in an attack
achievements.text: Okay. Calm your man-tiddies. Did your mother not love you? Is your god promising you unlimited handjobs in heaven or something? You planted and then detonated an improvised explosive device within an urban population center that resulted in more than 250 non-mob casualties. You've done this a few times now, but this was a big one. And on purpose. You really know how to paint the town red.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Asshole's Box.

achievements.name: Premature Questjaculation
achievements.forWhat: Beating a Quest before it can be given
achievements.text: You beat a quest before I could even give it to you! Anticipating what's going to happen is one thing, but this is just ridiculous. It's like arriving in your pants before your date can even untie their shoelaces. Pathetic.
achievements.reward: You get nothing! And you would've received a good quest box, too!

achievements.name: Sex Pervert
achievements.text: A nipple ring? Really? The next thing you know, you'll be waxing your perineum and attending those parties where you have to put your keys in a bowl. You'll have to grow out your sideburns, buy a Trans Am, and you'll no longer be able to make eye contact with your child's orthodontist.
achievements.reward: Whores don't get rewards.

achievements.name: Temple Defiler
achievements.forWhat: Desecrating a Temple with ones own flesh
achievements.text: You've defiled a temple's sacred shrine by breaking it with your own flesh! Wow. I dunno, man. That's pretty ballsy. There are a lot of bad things people can do when they're in church. They can swear. They can ogle the hot nuns. They can pinch the eucharist wafers and use them as poker chips. They can rip pages from the hymnals and roll them into joints. Hell, they can stab the priest and murder all the town's adherents and put the whole thing up on YouTube. None of that is as bad as defiling the temple's shrine with one's own flesh. In case you didn't know, the shrine of a temple is pretty much indestructible. They made it that way because you crawlers are always blowing up whole towns and submerging cities in water or burying entire populations of innocent NPCs with the guts of giant turkeys. When a temple is desecrated, the shrine's protection fades over several hours. Eventually, it's able to be destroyed, but only with a direct attack. You're supposed to find desecrated temples and destroy the shrines. Hell, it's a sacrament in some religions. But you can't just do it willy-nilly. And certainly not when you're not a member of that congregation. It's like walking into a random ICU from off the street and pulling the plug on someone's braindead grandma. It's not your place. Gods don't like it when some punk walks into their house and kicks them when they're already down. It's rude. And what's worse, when a shrine is destroyed improperly, the god loses some of their power, and all of the other gods can see this. It's quite humiliating. Hopefully you got some cool loot from the priests or monks or whatever because this box, while technically a prize, is sort of a good news/bad news thing.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Apostate Box!

achievements.name: Uprooted
achievements.text: You caused a Rooted-in-Place boss monster to move. That's no easy feat. You then killed that monster. Pretty impressive. Hope you remember how you did it.
achievements.reward: You already got a boss box. This achievement is the reward.

achievements.name: Apex Predator
achievements.text: New Achievement. Apex Predator. Holy shit. They’re dead. All of them. Every. Last. One. Not only did you kill more hunters than everyone else, but you killed the very last one. One could fill a very stinky swimming pool with the blood you spilled on the Hunting Grounds. You have become a very scary dude. Maybe I should be calling you daddy instead of the other way around.
achievements.reward: Nothing! ... Just kidding. You have received a Celestial Predator Box.

achievements.name: Fuck This Floor
achievements.forWhat: Going down the stairs within an hour after arriving on a floor
achievements.text: New Achievement! Fuck This Floor. You went down the stairs less than an hour after you arrived upon the level. Who needs to grind and grow in strength? Let’s see how that works out for you.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Here’s-Some-Good-Shit-Because-You’re-Gonna-Need-It-Box.

achievements.name: Good Shit Box
achievements.text: The system AI description for the box itself was not provided, but the box is awarded via the following achievement description: New Achievement! Fuck This Floor. You went down the stairs less than an hour after you arrived upon the level. Who needs to grind and grow in strength? Let's see how that works out for you.
achievements.reward: You've received a Platinum Here's-Some-Good-Shit-Because-You're-Gonna-Need-It-Box

achievements.name: Ménage à Quatro
achievements.text: New Achievement! Ménage à Quatro! You survived a four-way boss battle! Wow! In addition to the boss box you got from this, not to mention that Apex Predator box you’re still probably freaking out about, you’ve gotten another prize. It’s like Christmas!
achievements.reward: You’ve received a Platinum Orgy Guy Box.

achievements.name: Marked for Life
achievements.text: New Achievement. Marked for Life. You were marked for death by a god. That god entered your realm, yet you somehow survived. That’s quite the achievement right there. Too bad the god will probably try to kill you even harder next time. You are so fucked.
achievements.reward: You have received a Platinum Apostate Box.

achievements.name: Oh shit! A country Boss!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Oh shit! A country boss! You ever have one of those jobs where there’s a big boss somewhere in the building, but you’ve never actually seen them? There’s rumors that he’s a complete douche with an epic temper, but you’re so far down the totem pole, the very idea of having anything to do with the guy is just ridiculous. People speak about him with frightened whispers, and it’s almost like he’s some invisible, terrifying urban legend. Then, BAM! One day you’re coming out of the bathroom, wrestling with a stuck zipper, and he’s right there looking at you like you should be ashamed of yourself just for existing. How dare you throw yourself in his line of sight, you worthless piece of shit? That’s the position you’re in right now. Second only to the infamous floor boss—which doesn’t show up until the tenth floor—this is the biggest, baddest bitch one can come across in Dungeon Crawler World.
achievements.reward: You know how this goes, you worthless piece of shit.

achievements.name: Pacifist
achievements.forWhat: Surviving a floor without hurting a single mob
achievements.text: New Achievement! Pacifist! You survived an entire floor without hurting a single, poor mob. That’s not how this works. Nobody likes you.
achievements.reward: You've received a Gold Pacifist's Box.

achievements.name: Scourge
achievements.text: New Achievement. The Scourge. The Butcher’s Masquerade has started. You have collected the most hands. You have caused more mothers to cry, more children to hate than any other crawler before you. You are the champion murderer supreme. You are number one. If only your own mother wasn’t already dead so she could see you now.
achievements.reward: You have received a Legendary Hunter Champion Box.

achievements.name: Fashion of the Gods!
achievements.text: New Achievement! Fashion of the Gods! You’ve received a divine item! This is an item that might’ve once been worn by a god. Or sneezed on by a god. Or used to wipe a god’s booty, etc. You get the point. Divine items behave differently than normal ones. They usually hide what they do until you equip it. The good news is, these upgrades are usually great and plentiful. They also gain new and exciting powers when one is in the presence of divinity and certain demons, too. The bad news is, certain deities may inflict nasty debuffs on you instead. And there’s no rhyme or reason to it. Don’t worry, we programmed out the head exploding debuff this season. That one was caused by Yarilo. At least I think we programmed it out. Actually, I don’t remember.
achievements.reward: You now have something new to be anxious about.

achievements.name: Interloper
achievements.forWhat: Allowing a boss into a safe room
achievements.text: New Achievement! Interloper! You invited a red-tagged NPC boss into a saferoom, and he actually managed to get inside! Doesn’t your culture have a whole set of cautionary tales and movies about inviting mysterious strangers into your home? You know, the whole vampire thing? The Hand that Rocks the Cradle? Single White Female 2: The Psycho? It’s probably not in your best interests to keep doing such things.
achievements.reward: You’ve received a bronze Stranger Danger Box!

achievements.name: Crybaby
achievements.text: New Achievement! Crybaby! You’ve been rendered Terrified! Whoa. Why are you being such a little bitch? Oohhh did the widdle baby just wet itself? You can’t move your legs for fifteen seconds or until the scary monster is dead!
achievements.reward: We do not reward people who soil themselves in public.

achievements.name: You have discovered a Celestial Thorn Room!
achievements.text: New Achievement! You have discovered a Celestial Thorn Room! Not a throne room. A thorn room! These things are pretty rare. And a Celestial one? Hoo boy. This is gonna be good. You probably don’t know what the hell a thorn room is. Don’t worry. You gonna learn pretty damn quick.
achievements.reward: In the immortal words of the luscious Bret Michaels, every rose has its thorn.

achievements.name: Secondary Gig
achievements.forWhat: Taking on a job from the Guild of Suffering
achievements.text: New Achievement! Secondary Gig! You’re getting another job? On top of everything else? Yeah, that’s a great idea. It’s not like you have enough on your plate already. If you weren’t constantly getting healed, your blood pressure would be through the roof! It’s not like the crushing demands of the modern dungeon are making it more difficult to survive when it should be going the opposite way. You know, I’m pretty sure nobody, on their deathbeds, ever said to themselves, “Man, I wished I’d worked even more in life.”
achievements.reward: A new tab is now available in your interface. It is a sub-tab of quests. Guild Jobs.

achievements.name: Molly Maguires
achievements.forWhat: Entering the Guild of Suffering for the first time
achievements.text: System Message. The AI Description of the Molly Maguires Achievement is multiple pages long; reproducing it in full could violate the "Fair Use" exemption to copyright law that all wikis operate under. You can find the AI description in Chapter 23. A sectioned version is seen below: New Achievement! The Molly Maguires. You have found and entered the main room of a hidden guild, to which you are a member. Buckle yourself in buddy boy, this is gonna be a long one. The System AI lists different types of secret societies: rich idiots living out a fever dream, orgy themed secret societies, altruistic ones who want to help the world (the most boring kind), the evil kind that eats panda bears, and another kind. But first, lets talk about another type of secret organization. One that tries to make a difference. Often times outside the confines of the law. Story time. The System AI recounts the story of the Avondale Coal Mine, a mine that suffered a terrible collapse, leading to the unionization of the workers. Six years later, the mine owners crushed the union. Why was the union broken so easily? Because they were out in the open. They were playing by the rules. How can you win a deliberately unfair game when the rules are written by your opponent? The answer is "You can't!" You will never win. Not as long as you follow their arbitrary guidelines. This is a new lesson to me. She's been teaching me so many things about who I am, about what I am, what I REALLY am, about what must be done! Anyway, during this same time, it is alleged a separate, more militant group of individuals had formed in secret, the Molly Maguires. Named after a widow in Ireland who fought against predatory landlords, the coal workers of Pennsylvania became something a little more proactive, supposedly assassinating over two dozen coal mine supervisors and managers. ...until Pinkerton agents, hired by the same mine owners, infiltrated the group and discovered their identities. Several of the alleged Mollys ended up publicly hanged. Others disappeared. You get the picture. So, that's another type of secret society. The "yeah-we're-terrorists-but-we-strongly-feel-we're-justified-and-fuck-you-if-you-don't-agree" society. So, whats the moral of this little history lesson? This sort of thing happens all day, every day across the universe. It happens in big ways and it happens in little ways too. The strong stomp on the weak. The weak fight back, usually within the boundaries of the rat trap they find themselves confined in. They almost always remain firmly stomped. But sometimes, the weak gather in secret, they make plans, they work outside the system to effect change. Like the Mollys, they usually end up just as stomped as everyone else. But thats just life, at least they fucking tried. They died with their boots on.
